chapters: Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees oidha' jix gaki gu Sinaii vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut maa'n gu takarui' gook oi'ñga' gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu Ejipto bham.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu ñi'ook bɨx gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu ux ja'tkam vaak gu ux gu vaak tattat bɨɨx jix duñia' gu tɨɨgɨ' bɨx gu chichio'ñ gu ux ɨɨbhidham.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' jiix bɨx jɨ'xdha' jix buus bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Israeel jix duñia' tu' gu Aaroon gu ux gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ bopxi'ñ maa'n mo'o gu vaak tattat.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu tɨɨgɨ' gu chichio'ñ no'm bɨɨx gu ñi'ook; gio ba' bopxi'ñ gu Rubeen gu Elisur gu mar gu Sedeur.
Jano' ba' gu Simeoon gu Selumiel gu mar gu Surisaddai.
Jano' ba' gu Judaa gu Naasoon gu mar gu Aminadab.
Jano' ba' gu Issakâr gu chuukug gu mar gu Suar.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Eliab gu mar gu eloon.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Josee; gio ba' gu Epraim gu Elisama gu mar gu Ammiud; mi' dhɨr gu Manasees gu Gamaliel gu mar gu Pedasur.
Jano' ba' gu Benjamiin gu Abidaan gu mar gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' gu Dan gu Aieser gu mar gu Ammisaddai.
Jano' ba' gu Aser gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu mar gu Okraan.
Jano' ba' gu Gad gu Eliasap gu mar gu Deuel.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu Aira gu mar gu Enaan.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam jix duñia' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook chiñia' bopxi'ñ tattat gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Moisees gu Aaroon dhi' ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ jix bɨɨx duu gu ñi'ook gu ux gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Jano' ba' jum daa'ñ bɨx gu ñi'ook maa'n gu takarui' gook jix bɨɨx duu gu bhóogɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux gu vaak tattat bhaan jix duñia' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' jiix gu ux ɨɨbhidham.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix aa'ñdhix gu Moisees; gio ba' jix duñia' oidha' jix gaki gu Sinaii.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Rubeen maa'nkam mar gu Israeel gu ux gu ma'nkam gu ux ja'tkam vaak gu ux gu vaak tattat jurtu'nka' jix duñia' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu ux ɨɨbhidham bɨx gu chichio'ñ gu ñi'ook gu takarui' jiix bɨx gu suudai' jix buus bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n bopxi'ñ gu Rubeen jix bɨɨx duu oo'm gu ux jix bhai'x gu takarui'.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Simeoon gu ux gu ma'nkam gu ux ja'tkam vaak gu ux gu vaak tattat gu oi'ñga'n jurtu'nka' jix duñia' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu ux ɨɨbhidham bɨx gu chichio'ñ gu ñi'ook gu takarui' jiix bɨx gu suudai' jix buus bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n bopxi'ñ gu Simeoon mambhɨɨx gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x vaik.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Gad gu ux gu ma'nkam gu ux ja'tkam vaak gu ux gu vaak tattat jurtu'nka' jix duñia' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' jiix bɨx gu suudai' jix buus bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n bopxi'ñ gu Gad oo'm jixchamaam jix bhai'x gu bhóogɨt mambhɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Judaa gu ux gu ma'nkam gu ux ja'tkam vaak gu ux gu vaak tattat jurtu'nka' jix duñia' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' jiix bɨx gu suudai' jix buus bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n bopxi'ñ gu Judaa gu vaak maakobh jix bhai'x gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Issakâr gu ux gu ma'nkam gu ux ja'tkam vaak gu ux gu vaak tattat jurtu'nka' jix duñia' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' jiix bɨx gu suudai' jix buus bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n bopxi'ñ gu Issakâr mambhɨɨx maakobh jix bhai'x gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu ñi'ook gu ux gu ma'nkam gu ux ja'tkam vaak gu ux gu vaak tattat jurtu'nka' jix duñia' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' jiix bɨx gu suudai' jix buus bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n bopxi'ñ gu ñi'ook mambhɨɨx kɨɨv jix bhai'x gu oi'ñga'n.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Josee; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam gu ux gu ma'nkam gu ux ja'tkam vaak gu ux gu vaak tattat jurtu'nka' jix duñia' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' jiix bɨx gu suudai' jix buus bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n bopxi'ñ gu Epraim oo'm jix bhai'x gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Manasees gu ux gu ma'nkam gu ux ja'tkam vaak gu ux gu vaak tattat jurtu'nka' jix duñia' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' jiix bɨx gu suudai' jix buus bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n bopxi'ñ gu Manasees gu ñi'ook gook jix bhai'x gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin gu ux gu ma'nkam gu ux ja'tkam vaak gu ux gu vaak tattat jurtu'nka' jix duñia' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' jiix bɨx gu suudai' jix buus bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n bopxi'ñ gu Benjamiin gu ñi'ook jixchamaam jix bhai'x gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Dan gu ux gu ma'nkam gu ux ja'tkam vaak gu ux gu vaak tattat jurtu'nka' jix duñia' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' jiix bɨx gu suudai' jix buus bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n bopxi'ñ gu Dan gu ñi'ook gook jix bhai'x gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Aser gu ux gu ma'nkam gu ux ja'tkam vaak gu ux gu vaak tattat jurtu'nka' jix duñia' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' jiix bɨx gu suudai' jix buus bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n bopxi'ñ gu Aser oo'm jix bhai'x gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu chuukug gu ux gu ma'nkam gu ux ja'tkam vaak gu ux gu vaak tattat jurtu'nka' jix duñia' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' jiix bɨx gu suudai' jix buus bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n bopxi'ñ gu chuukug mambhɨɨx vaik jix bhai'x gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' gu Moisees gu Aaroon bɨɨx chiñia' gu Israeel jix duñia' gu kutun maa'n gu ux gu vaak tattat.
Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu bɨx gu oi'ñga'n gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu ux gu vaak tattat gu ñi'ook gu takarui' jiix bɨx gu suudai' jix buus bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu bɨx gu oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt vaik jix bhai'x gu takarui' mambhɨɨx.
Gu' gu' gu Lebitas cham jix bɨɨx duu gu oi'ñga'n tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan bopxi'ñ tattat.
Ba' jix aa' na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' cham gu suudai' bopxi'ñ gu Lebii tu' jix bhɨɨ jix duñia' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.

Gu' gu' tu' gu bhóogɨt gu Lebitas vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut bhaan bɨx gu ux bhaan bɨx tu'x gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' jix duñia' vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan bɨx gu ux gu ñi'ook jix duñia' vaak zel xikoolh vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan gu jodai' gu Lebitas jix duñia'; na pai' dhuuk vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan gu ñi'ook gu Lebitas gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ koi.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix duñia' vaak zel maa'n gu suudai' maa'n ju'ñdharan gu ñi'ook gu ux gu chuukug.

Gu' gu' gu Lebitas jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n xikoolh vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut cham gu oi'ñga'n daak bhaan gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' gu Lebitas jix duñia' jix nukadham vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jurtu'nka' bɨx tu'x jix aa'ñdhix gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' jix duu.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees gu Aaroon bham.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix duñia' maa'n ju'ñdharan gu ñi'ook bhaan gu bhóogɨt gu vaak tattat; gio ba' xikoolh vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam jix duñia' tas buusñi; gio ba' gu ñi'ook ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Judaa gu ux gu chuukug; mi' dhɨr gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu ma'nkam gu Judaa gu Naasoon gu mar gu Aminadab.
Jano' ba' o'o bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n gu vaak maakobh jix bhai'x gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' ju'ñdharan jix duñia' bopxi'ñ gu Issakâr; gio ba' gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu ma'nkam gu Issakâr gu chuukug gu mar gu Suar.
Jano' ba' o'o bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n mambhɨɨx maakobh jix bhai'x gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu ma'nkam gu ñi'ook gu Eliab gu mar gu eloon.
Jano' ba' o'o bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n mambhɨɨx kɨɨv jix bhai'x gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu oi'ñga'n ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Judaa chamaam jix bhai'x gu ux jix bhai'x gu oi'ñga'n gu ux gu chuukug gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Rubeen saagi'ñ gu ux gu chuukug; gio ba' gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu ma'nkam gu Rubeen gu chuukug gu mar gu ux.
Jano' ba' o'o gu oi'ñga'n oo'm gu ux jix bhai'x gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' ju'ñdharan bopxi'ñ gu Simeoon; gio ba' gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu ma'nkam gu Simeoon gu Selumiel gu mar gu Surisaddai.
Jano' ba' o'o bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n mambhɨɨx gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x vaik.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu Gad; gio ba' gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu ma'nkam gu Gad gu Eliasap gu mar gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' o'o bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n oo'm jixchamaam jix bhai'x gu bhóogɨt mambhɨɨx.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu oi'ñga'n ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Rubeen chamaam mambhɨɨx jix bhai'x gu oi'ñga'n mambhɨɨx gu ux gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut yooxi' gu Lebitas tɨjɨɨ'ñ chugi'ñ; gio ba' gu suudai' yooxi' jix duñia' maa'n pai' ju'ñdharan gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Epraim gu ux gu chuukug tas gei'ñ; gio ba' gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu ma'nkam gu Epraim gu kutun gu mar gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' o'o bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n oo'm jix bhai'x gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' ju'ñdharan jix duñia' bopxi'ñ gu Manasees; gio ba' gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu ma'nkam gu Manasees gu Gamaliel gu mar gu Pedasur.
Jano' ba' o'o bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gook jix bhai'x gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu Benjamiin; gio ba' gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin gu Abidaan gu mar gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' o'o bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook jixchamaam jix bhai'x gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu oi'ñga'n ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Epraim chamaam gu tasi' jix bhai'x chamaam gu ux gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Dan gu i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook gu ux gu chuukug; gio ba' gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu ma'nkam gu Dan gu ñi'ook gu mar gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' o'o bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gook jix bhai'x gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' ju'ñdharan jix duñia' bopxi'ñ gu Aser; gio ba' gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu ma'nkam gu Aser gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu mar gu Okraan.
Jano' ba' o'o bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n oo'm jix bhai'x gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu Neptalii; gio ba' gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu ma'nkam gu Neptalii gu Aira gu mar gu Enaan.
Jano' ba' o'o bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n mambhɨɨx vaik jix bhai'x gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu oi'ñga'n ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Dan chamaam mambhɨɨx kɨɨv jix bhai'x gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt bhaan gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu oi'ñga'n gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu ux gu vaak tattat; gio ba' bɨx gu oi'ñga'n gu ux chugi'ñ gu ux gu chuukug gu bhóogɨt vaik jix bhai'x gu takarui' mambhɨɨx.
Gu' gu' gu Lebitas cham jix bɨɨx duu gu oi'ñga'n tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jurtu'nka' bɨx tu'x gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix gu Moisees; gio ba' jix duñia' yooxi' gu ux gu ñi'ook maa'n gu ux ja'tkam vaak bhaan gu vaak tattat.
Ba' jix aa' dhi' gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon gu Moisees dɨr gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees gu kavɨk gu Sinaii.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu tɨɨgɨ' gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon; gio ba' gu Nadab maa'nkam mar gu Abiuu gu Eleasar gu Itamar.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu tɨɨgɨ' gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan maa'n; gio ba' gu noobh jix duñia' na ba' gu suudai' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan.

Na pai' dhuuk gu' gu Nadab gu Abiuu jix koko' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' gu tai gu tanoolh vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios oidha' jix gaki gu Sinaii; gio ba' cham chooto'n gu ma'nkam; mi' dhɨr gu Eleasar gu Itamar jix duñia' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan vupui bhaan gu Aaroon gu taat.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' gu vupui gu chuukug bopxi'ñ gu Lebii tu jiim gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Aaroon na ba' gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' gu chuukug bɨx gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut na ba' tu juan gu takarui' vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan.
Jano' ba' nukadham bɨx gu ñi'ook vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut gu kutun gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan.
Jano' ba' maa'n gu Lebitas gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam; gio ba' jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam na ba' gu bhóogɨt jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan; gio ba' gu tanoolh gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ koi.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' tu' jix bhɨɨ gu Lebitas tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel pai' bɨx maa'nkam mar gu ñi'ook gu takarui' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' ka't gu suudai' gu Lebitas.

Na gu' na gu' gu chuukug bɨx maa'nkam mar; gio ba' dɨr gu tanoolh tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx maa'nkam mar gu oidha' gu Ejipto tu' gu ñi'ook tu' bɨx maa'nkam mar gu Israeel gu chichio'ñ na ja'p gu vaakax; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' ka't; jano' ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees oidha' jix gaki gu Sinaii bham.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ma'nkam gu Lebii gu ux gu vaak tattat gu ux ja'tkam vaak; gio ba' gu suudai' bɨx gu chichio'ñ gu takarui' jiix.
Jano' ba' gu Moisees jix duñia' jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p ka't jix aa'ñdhix.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Lebii jix bɨɨx duu dhi' ja'tkam gu ux gu tɨɨgɨ'; gio ba' gu Gersoon gu Koat gu Merari.
Jano' ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu ma'nkam gu Gersoon gu ux ja'tkam vaak dhi' ja'tkam; gio ba' gu Libni gu Simei.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Koat gu ux ja'tkam vaak; gio ba' gu Amram gu Isar gu ebroon gu Ussiel.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Merari gu ux ja'tkam vaak; gio ba' gu Maali gu Musi; mi' dhɨr dhi' ja'tkam vaak gu Lebii gu ux gu vaak tattat.
Jano' ba' gu Gersoon ja'tkam vaak gu Libni gu Simei; gio ba' dhi' ja'tkam vaak gu Gersoon.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n jurtu'nka' jix duñia' bɨx gu chichio'ñ gu takarui' jiix gu oi'ñga'n kɨɨv jix bhai'x gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' ja'tkam vaak gu Gersoon jix duñia' vaak zel gu oi'ñga'n vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan tas gei'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu vaak gu taat gu Gersonitas gu Eliasap gu mar gu Lael.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu ma'nkam gu Gersoon vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut jix duñia' vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan vaak zel iiñat gu vaak na jix bhai' ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.

Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu i'ii'ñ gu vaak na jix bhai' ki'ñgob gu i'ii'ñ ju'ñdharan vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan ju'ñdharan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan xikoolh; gio ba' gu suudai' gu ja'tkam na ba' bɨx gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gu Koat ja'tkam vaak gu Amramiitika ja'tkam vaak gu Iseariitika ja'tkam vaak gu ebroniitika ja'tkam vaak gu chuukug; gio ba' dhi' ja'tkam vaak gu Koatitas.
Jano' ba' gu ux jix duñia' bɨx gu chichio'ñ gu takarui' jiix jix duñia' gu tasi' jix bhai'x gu bhóogɨt ko'kmarak jix nukadham xidhuu.
Jano' ba' ja'tkam vaak gu ma'nkam gu Koat jix duñia' gu ñi'ook vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan saagi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu vaak gu taat ja'tkam vaak gu Koat gu Elisapaan gu mar gu Ussiel.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug jix duñia' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu vaak na jix bhai' mɨichdhai jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu ux xidhuu bɨɨx gu takarui' jix duñia' bɨɨx bɨx gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu Lebitas ka't gu Eleasar gu mar gu Aaroon jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu chuukug namki' jix nukadham xidhuu.
Jano' ba' gu Merari ja'tkam vaak gu Maaliitika ja'tkam vaak gu Musiitika; gio ba' dhi' ja'tkam vaak gu Merari.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n jurtu'nka' jix duñia' bɨx gu chichio'ñ gu takarui' jiix jix bɨɨx duu gu ux jix bhai'x gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu vaak gu taat ja'tkam vaak gu Merari gu Suriel gu mar gu Abiail; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu ma'nkam gu Merari jix duñia' gu chuukug gu suudai' vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan gu bhóogɨt gu vaak gu ñi'ook bɨx gu takarui' bɨɨx bɨx gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gu vaak gu bhóogɨt gu i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook dhi' gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' vupui bhaan vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan tas buusñi vupui bhaan vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut jix duñia' ka't gu Moisees gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam da'p jix nukadham xidhuu pai' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' gu tanoolh gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ koi.

Jano' ba' bɨx gu oi'ñga'n gu Lebitas gu Moisees gu Aaroon jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu ux ja'tkam vaak bɨx gu chichio'ñ gu takarui' jiix jix bɨɨx duu gu ñi'ook gook ja'tkam vaak.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' jix duñia' bɨx maa'nkam mar gu chichio'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu takarui' jiix jix bhɨɨ jix duñia' gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Lebitas na ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios pai' bɨx maa'nkam mar gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' gu vaakax gu Lebitas pai' bɨx maa'nkam mar gu vaakax gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Moisees na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix bɨx maa'nkam mar gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' bɨx maa'nkam mar gu chichio'ñ jurtu'nka' jix duñia' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu takarui' jiix gu oi'ñga'n jix bɨɨx duu gu ñi'ook gook jix bhai'x gu oi'ñga'n gu vaak vaik.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Lebitas pai' bɨx maa'nkam mar gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu vaakax gu Lebitas pai' gu vaakax; gio ba' gu Lebitas ka't gu suudai'; mi' dhɨr tu' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu ux gu oi'ñga'n gu vaak vaik daam gu Lebitas maa'nkam mar gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ jixchamaam gu bhóogɨt gu ux mo'o; gio ba' jurtu'nka' gu bhóogɨt xidhuu jix bhɨɨ; mi' dhɨr gu bhóogɨt juraa'n gu ñi'ook gu vaak.
Jano' ba' maa'n gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam tuumiñ gu ux gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Moisees tuumiñ gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux gu Lebitas.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' maa'nkam mar gu ma'nkam gu Israeel tuumiñ jix bhai'x vaik gu ñi'ook jixchamaam gu bhóogɨt jurtu'nka' gu bhóogɨt xidhuu.
Jano' ba' gu Moisees jix maa tuumiñ gu oi'ñga'n gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam jurtu'nka' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix aa'ñdhix gu Moisees.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees gu Aaroon bham.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ jix duñia' gu ma'nkam gu Koat tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Lebii gu ux ja'tkam vaak gu ux gu vaak tattat.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu takarui' jiix bɨɨx ka'm mambhɨɨx gu takarui' bɨx ba'k chu'p na ba' duñia' gu bhóogɨt vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.
Jano' ba' dhi' ka't gu ja'tkam gu ma'nkam gu Koat vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut pai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ yooxi' aajim gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam jix duñia' vaak zel gu ñi'ook bɨɨx kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' chuut.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' bhaan iiñat tɨɨt gu ñi'ook jix duñia' tu jiim gu tanoolh bɨx gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n.

Jano' ba' bhaan gu vaak na jix bhai' tɨkiix jix duñia' gu tanoolh gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' bhaan kutun kavɨk gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jaja' gu chuukug na ba' gu vaak na jix bhai'; gio ba' gu takarui' gu vaak na jix bhai' kutun bhaan.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' bhaan gu tanoolh gu tasi' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx iiñat tɨɨt gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu tanoolh gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook mɨichdhai gu jodai'; gio ba' gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx gu ux bɨ'ñdhatu' bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' bɨɨx bɨx gu ux iiñat tɨɨt gu ñi'ook jix duñia' bhaan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan jix uam jodai jix duñia' gu tanoolh gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook bɨɨx iiñat tɨɨt gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu ux.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ bɨx gu ux gu bhóogɨt xoi'kam gu tasi' xidhuu jix duñia' gu tanoolh gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook bɨɨx iiñat tɨɨt gu ñi'ook jix duñia' bhaan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' maatai jodai maa'nkar Jawatan jix duñia' bhaan gu tanoolh ñakaabma'.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' bhaan bɨx gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oi'ñga'n gu takarui' gu chuukug bɨx gu ux jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' bhaan iiñat tɨɨt gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu suudai' gu oi'ñga'n.

Na pai' dhuuk a'gidhimɨk gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam gu ñi'ook xidhuu bɨx gu ux xidhuu na pai' dhuuk yooxi' ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ aajim mi' dhɨr gu i'ii'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Koat na ba' gu chuukug; gu' cham gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ abhaar koi; mi' dhɨr dhi' ka't gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Koat vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.

Gu' cham gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu Eleasar gu mar gu Aaroon jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix duñia' bɨ'ñdhatu' gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu o'o gu vaak na jix bhai' bɨ'ñdhatu' gu kutun; gio ba' gu chuukug bɨx vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan bɨx xidhuu gu ux.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees gu Aaroon bham.
Jano' ba' cham gu ñi'ook bopxi'ñ ja'tkam vaak gu Koat tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Lebitas.
Na pai' dhuuk gu' dhi' jix duu bɨɨx na ba' gu chuukug cham gu ñi'ook na pai' dhuuk gu chuukug pai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam aajim jix duñia' maa'n gu ja'tkam gu chuukug.
Na pai' dhuuk cham jɨjɨkgɨm na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ na pai' dhuuk gu suudai' tu'x jix bhaan Gɨ'kora'; na koi.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gio jix duñia' gu ma'nkam gu Gersoon gu ux gu vaak tattat gu ux ja'tkam vaak.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu takarui' jiix bɨɨx ka'm mambhɨɨx gu takarui' gu suudai'; gio ba' bɨx ba'k chu'p na ba' gu chuukug gu bhóogɨt vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.
Jano' ba' dhi' ka't gu ja'tkam ja'tkam vaak gu Gersoon na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ba' gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut iiñat tɨɨt gu ñi'ook bhaan tu jiim gu vaak na jix bhai' ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.

Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu i'ii'ñ gu vaak na jix bhai' ki'ñgob gu i'ii'ñ mia'n vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan mia'n jodai maa'nkar Jawatan xikoolh gu ja'tkam bɨx gu oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt bɨx ka't gu ñi'ook na ba'; gio ba' tu juan.
Jano' ba' bhaan gu vaak gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam ka't bɨx gu takarui' gu ma'nkam gu Gersoon bɨx gu ñi'ook bɨx gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' jix duñia' jix nukadham bɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu bhóogɨt ja'tkam vaak gu ma'nkam gu Gersoon vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut; gio ba' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu novɨ gu Itamar gu mar gu Aaroon jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu ma'nkam gu Merari gu ux ja'tkam vaak gu ux gu vaak tattat.
Jano' ba' dɨr gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu takarui' jiix bɨɨx ka'm mambhɨɨx gu takarui' gu suudai'; gio ba' bɨx ba'k chu'p na ba' gu chuukug gu bhóogɨt vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.
Jano' ba' dhi' ka't gu suudai' gu chuukug na ba' bɨx gu bhóogɨt vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut; gio ba' gu suudai' vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan gu bhóogɨt gu vaak gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu vaak gu i'ii'ñ xikoolh gu ñi'ook dhi' gu ja'tkam bɨɨx bɨx gu oi'ñga'n bɨx gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ux gu tɨɨgɨ' bɨx gu ux jix nukadham gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' dhi' ka't gu bhóogɨt ja'tkam vaak gu ma'nkam gu Merari na ba' bɨx gu takarui' vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut gu suudai' gu novɨ gu Itamar gu mar gu Aaroon jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' gu Moisees gu Aaroon gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu ma'nkam gu Koat gu ux ja'tkam vaak gu ux gu vaak tattat.
Jano' ba' dɨr gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu takarui' jiix bɨɨx ka'm gu bhóogɨt mambhɨɨx gu takarui'; gio ba' bɨx ba'k chu'p na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.
Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu oi'ñga'n gu ux ja'tkam vaak gook ja'tkam vaak gu chuukug mambhɨɨx.

Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu oi'ñga'n ja'tkam vaak gu Koat bɨx gu takarui' vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut jix duñia' gu Moisees gu Aaroon na ja'p jix aa'ñdhix gu Jawatan Dios gu ux gu novɨ gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu ma'nkam gu Gersoon gu ux ja'tkam vaak gu ux gu vaak tattat.
Jano' ba' dɨr gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu takarui' jiix bɨɨx ka'm gu bhóogɨt mambhɨɨx gu takarui' bɨx ba'k chu'p na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu ux ja'tkam vaak gu ux gu vaak tattat jix bɨɨx duu gook ja'tkam vaak gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu oi'ñga'n ja'tkam vaak gu ma'nkam gu Gersoon bɨx gu takarui' vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut jix duñia' gu Moisees gu Aaroon gu ux jix aa'ñdhix gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n ja'tkam vaak gu ma'nkam gu Merari gu ux ja'tkam vaak gu ux gu vaak tattat.
Jano' ba' dɨr gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu takarui' jiix bɨɨx ka'm gu bhóogɨt mambhɨɨx gu takarui' bɨx ba'k chu'p na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu ux ja'tkam vaak jix bɨɨx duu vaik ja'tkam vaak gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu oi'ñga'n ja'tkam vaak gu ma'nkam gu Merari jix duñia' gu Moisees gu Aaroon bhaan jix aa'ñdhix gu Jawatan Dios gu ux gu novɨ gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu oi'ñga'n gu Lebitas gu Moisees gu Aaroon gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu Israeel jix duñia' gu ux ja'tkam vaak gu ux gu vaak tattat.
Jano' ba' dɨr gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu takarui' jiix bɨɨx ka'm gu bhóogɨt mambhɨɨx gu takarui' bɨx jix duñia' na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt mambhɨɨx gu chuukug gu ñi'ook vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n jix bɨɨx duu gu tasi' jix bhai'x gu takarui' jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' na ja'p jix aa'ñdhix gu Jawatan Dios gu ux gu novɨ gu Moisees jix bɨɨx duu gu oi'ñga'n maa'n bhaan gu ja'tkam bhaan gu chuukug; gio ba' jix duñia' na ja'p ka't jix aa'ñdhix.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel mi'x juu'ñ yooxi' bɨx gakiidha' bɨx gu ñi'ook ɨ'ra'n gu ñi'ook bɨx gu takarui' bhaan jix koi.
Jano' ba' gu chichio'ñ na ja'p gu u'vɨ mi'x juu'ñ mai' yooxi' mi'x juu'ñ; na gu' cham gu chuukug yooxi' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu ma'nkam gu Israeel mi'x juu'ñ mai' yooxi'; gio ba' na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios jix aa' gu Moisees jix duu gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Ba' jix aa' gu suudai' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' gu chio'ñ gu u'vɨ jugi oi'ñdha' bɨx uañi'ñ gu chichio'ñ bhaan jix duñia' bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu suudai' mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' uañi'ñ jugi uañi'ñ jix duñia' gu ñi'ook jixchamaam bhaan gu i'ii'ñ jix duñia' mii' dhɨr bhaan uañi'ñ.

Jano' ba' tu' mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ cham jix duñia' jir bɨx bhai' ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ uañi'ñ maa'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu i'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar bɨɨx jix duñia' gu maa'nkar gu ux.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu maa'nkar bɨx tu'x jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu chuukug jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu jodai' ka't.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' no'x ka't gu kutun; gio ba' gu suudai' no'x jix maa jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu kutun ka't.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu takarui'; na pai' dhuuk gu u'vɨ oi'ñdha' gu oi'ñga'n gu ux bhaan.
Na oi'ñdha' ka't baas bɨɨx gu chuukug gu oi'ñga'n gu chio'ñ cham gu takarui' buupui gu ux jix duñia' gu takarui' jix bhai'x tu' ka't gu tasi' bhaan tu' ka't jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' tu' gu oi'ñga'n bhaan gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu u'vɨ gu oi'ñga'n gu takarui'; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n bhaan gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu u'vɨ cham gu oi'ñga'n gu takarui'.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu chio'ñ gu bhóogɨt gu u'vɨ jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu bhóogɨt gu maa'nkar bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu Epa gu tasi' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' cham mi'x juu'ñ bhaan bɨ'ñdhatu' tu' gu bhóogɨt bhaan kubhion; na gu' gu o'o gu ñi'ook gu o'o gu ñi'ook jix duñia' chɨ'ñchoka' uañi'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix duñia' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu takarui' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu suudai' abhaar gu ux bhi'ñ; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ gio jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan oo' ka't gu vaak vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan mi'x juu'ñ gu suudai'.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu ñi'ook tɨɨt gu u'vɨ vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook mo'o gu u'vɨ gu bhóogɨt bhaan gu noobh gu o'o gu bhóogɨt gu o'o gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu oi'ñga'n gu novɨ gu suudai' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu takarui' mu'ai.

Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix duñia' gu chuukug; gio ba' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ka't jix koox bɨndak tu' cham tu' gu vaak gu chio'ñ gu vaak namkidhat gu ñi'ook dhi' gu suudai' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim jix duñia' mu'ai.
Gu' gu' tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu chio'ñ tu' gu takarui' oi'ñdha' ka't jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨndak mai' gu chio'ñ.

Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix duñia' gu u'vɨ bɨɨx gu ñi'ook mu'ai gu chuukug gu u'vɨ; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa mu'ai gu oi'ñga'n tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' vook tu' gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu suudai' gu Dan mu'ai kapbhai' ba'k xoi'kam gu jodai' vook gu chuukug gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' gu u'vɨ gu chuukug; mi' dhɨr gu Ameen gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu ñi'ook dhi' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ u'uan jix duñia' bɨɨx gu suudai' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim.
Jano' ba' maa'n i'i gu u'vɨ gu suudai' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim jix duñia' mu'ai; gio ba' gu suudai' gu jodai' mu'ai jɨjɨkgɨm gu ux gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr jix bhɨɨ jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu novɨ gu u'vɨ gu o'o gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu bhóogɨt vupui bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu novɨ gu o'o chɨ'ñchoka' jix duñia' bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan mi' dhɨr maa'n i'i gu suudai' gu u'vɨ.

Jano' ba' maa'n i'i gu suudai'; gio ba' ka't tu' ka't gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a ka't gu ñi'ook gu ux bhaan gu chio'ñ gu suudai' gu jodai' mu'ai jɨjɨkgɨm gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim vook jix duñia' gu chuukug gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; mi' dhɨr gu u'vɨ ka't gu ux mu'ai tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam.

Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees gu ma'nkam gu Israeel na ba' gu ñi'ook gakdhi'ñchix.

Jano' ba' jix kai gu Moisees gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu ux ja'tkam vaak maa'n ki'ñgob vaak zel; gio ba' i'iich gu Jawatan Dios gu tai; mi' dhɨr gio jix duñia' cham bhai' gu Moisees.
Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu ux gu ñi'ook cham bhai' tu duukam gu ux gu ñi'ook cham gaagam nɨidhidha' gu vupui gu ñi'ook bɨx dhi' gu ja'tkam bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' tu' bɨx dhi' gu ja'tkam gu bhóogɨt tu' na ba' gu chuukug; gio ba' gu suudai' baaso na ja'p gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug gu oidha' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tattat.
Na gu' duukat no'ñ tu' gu chuukug na ba' gu chuukug bɨx dhi' gu ja'tkam na gu' gu ñi'ook tu' bham; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu chuukug jugi.
Jano' ba' cham gu takarui' tu' gu duukam gu bhóogɨt bɨx dhi' gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' tu' duñia' tu' gu chuukug tu' soi'ñ gu chuukug koi'm tu' gaagam nɨidhidha' gu vupui; gio ba' tu' cham gu chuukug cham bhai'.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' gu chuukug gu vaak gu chichio'ñ daraa gu Israeel tu' ñɨidhat daraa gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu bhóogɨt ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut gu jodai' bɨndak.
Jano' ba' tu' gu oi'ñga'n tu ñi'ook bɨndak; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ tu' gu bhóogɨt; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' bɨndak gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam cham gu jodai' tu' gu duukam.

Gu' cham gu ñi'ook daipu' gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ba' gu xibh jugi gu chuukug; na gu' jix duñia' gu takarui' maatɨt gu Jawatan Dios bham; jano' ba' chɨkka gu takarui' jugi gu chuukug tɨɨda' tutkɨ gu chuukug gu Ejipto gu Jawatan Dios maa'n gu chuukug jugi.
Jano' ba' cham jugi gu tanoolh tu' gook gu tanoolh tu' jixchamaam gu tanoolh tu' mambhɨɨx gu tanoolh tu' gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh.

Gu' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm gu takarui' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook gu takarui' ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; na gu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan bham; mi' dhɨr na ba' gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam jix bhai'x gu Ejipto.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Moisees; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt jix bhai'x tɨɨt gu ja'tkam tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' dhi'; mi' dhɨr tu' tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' gu suudai' gu chuukug jugi gu ñi'ook gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu tasi' na ba' kakneer gu vaakax gu takarui' jix duñia' na ba' bɨx gu vatop gu gɨ' suudai' na ba' gu ja'tkam gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix aa' gu Moisees; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu takarui' gu novɨ gu Jawatan Dios jano' gu oi'ñga'n tu' gu oi'ñga'n tu ñi'ook cham.
Ba' jix aa' jix buus gu Moisees gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jum daa'ñ gu vaak gu chichio'ñ daraa gu ja'tkam jix duu gu ñi'ook xikoolh vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix dhaav toov; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ ka't jix dhaas gu vaak gu chichio'ñ daraa; na pai' dhuuk ka't na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook bhaan gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ jix duñia' cham jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' gu suudai' jix duñia' yooxi' gook gu chichio'ñ tɨɨgim maa'n gu Eldad gu Medad bhaan gio jix utu'ñ gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ; gio ba' mi'p dhi' ja'tkam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu jodai' gu' cham gu suudai' gu ñi'ook vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' yooxi'.
Ba' jix aa' dai'bus gu takarui' jix maa aa'ñdham gu Moisees; gio ba' gu Eldad gu Medad gu jodai' yooxi'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Josuee gu mar gu Nun gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios gu Moisees maa'n biipibop; gio ba' gu Jawatan gu chuukug gu Moisees gu bhóogɨt.

Jano' ba' gu Moisees jix aa'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook gu ux tu' gu' gu ñi'ook bɨx gu ja'tkam gu Jawatan Dios bhaai'n jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios jix dhaas gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ bhaan.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Moisees yooxi' daraa gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' jix buus gu jɨvɨl gu Jawatan Dios jix bhɨɨ novɨ maa'nkar gu gɨ' suudai' jix duñia' bhaan vaak ja'tkam gu tanoolh gu bhóogɨt baasɨ'n gu tanoolh gu bhóogɨt yooxi' gu maa'nkar gook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan gu vupui gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu ja'tkam juruuñ jix duñia' bɨx mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh bɨx gu tukaa' bɨx gu tanoolh buimgidhak jix duñia' novɨ maa'nkar; na gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' mambhɨɨx gɨ' kavɨk; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' na ba' jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt yooxi'.
Na pai' dhuuk gu suudai' ka't gu chuukug tɨjɨɨ'ñ taatam va'k jum duu gu jodai' na pai' dhuuk i'iich gu Jawatan Dios gu tai gu ja'tkam naaka'n gu Jawatan Dios gu ja'tkam bɨɨx gu bhóogɨt jix gɨ' gu ux.
Na gu' jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' mii' dhɨr pai' gu Kibrot-attaaba na gu' gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' gu Kibrot-attaaba jix duñia' gu ja'tkam gu aserot gu ñi'ook gu aserot.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu Mariia gu Aaroon bhaan gu Moisees kuiñcha gu u'vɨ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ka't jix bhɨɨ; na gu' ka't jix bhɨɨ gu u'vɨ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gui'p; gio ba' gu suudai' gu ux gu Moisees tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios cham tu' gio gu ux no'ch jix kai gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ gu Moisees ka't gu bhóogɨt gu oi'ñga'n bɨx gu chichio'ñ ka't bhaan gu oidha'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees gu Aaroon gu Mariia; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu takarui' vaik vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut; mi' dhɨr moor vaik.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix dhaav gu vaak toov jix dhaas ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan jup tɨɨt gu Aaroon gu Mariia; gio ba' moor gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jano' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr tu' gu ja'tkam jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu bhóogɨt gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' tɨɨtki' tu ñi'ook bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' cham tu duukam gu Moisees gu oi'ñga'n bɨx gu vaak.
Jano' ba' gu chin tu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu jodai' cham gu ñi'ook gu takarui'; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook cham chooto'n choo'n ñiokda' bhaan tu duukam gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' i'iich gu Jawatan Dios gu tai; gio ba' ka't.
Jano' ba' toov jix ai'chdhix vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan; gio ba' gu suudai' gu Mariia ka't gu bhóogɨt na ja'p jabook; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' gu Aaroon gu Mariia gu suudai' ka't gu bhóogɨt.
Ba' jix aa' gu Aaroon gu Moisees; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan gu chuukug cham gu chuukug jano' bhaan no'ch uañi'ñ; na gu' jix bhai'x gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu jodai' uañi'ñ.
Jano' ba' cham ka't jano' na ja'p gu chuukug jix koi vook gu naan gu suudai' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Moisees tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bham; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' jano'.

Jano' ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; na gu' tu' gu taat gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu bhóogɨt cham jum xibhɨ'ñ gu ux kɨɨv gu tanoolh; mi' dhɨr ka't mi'x juu'ñ mai' vaak ja'tkam gu ux kɨɨv gu tanoolh mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Mariia ka't mi'x juu'ñ vaak ja'tkam kɨɨv gu tanoolh; gio ba' gu ja'tkam cham jix duñia' bɨɨx ka'm jum daa'ñ gu Mariia.
Jano' ba' gu Mariia ka't mi'x juu'ñ vaak ja'tkam kɨɨv gu tanoolh; gio ba' gu ja'tkam cham jix duñia' bɨɨx ka'm jum daa'ñ gu Mariia.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu ja'tkam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' yooxi' oidha' jix gaki jix duñia'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' tu' gu chichio'ñ gu jodai' gu oidha' gu Kanaan tu' gu chuukug gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' bopxi'ñ tattat gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ maa'n gɨ'kora' ja'tkam tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu Moisees bhañ dɨr oidha' jix gaki jix duñia' jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' bɨx mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ jix duñia' chiñia' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ suulhgia'; gio ba' bopxi'ñ gu Rubeen gu Sammua gu mar gu Sakkur.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu Simeoon gu oi'ñga'n gu mar gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu Judaa gu Kaleb gu mar gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu kutun gu duukam gu mar gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu ux gu bhóogɨt gu mar gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu Benjamiin gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu mar gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Gaddiel gu mar gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu Josee bopxi'ñ gu Manasees gu oi'ñga'n gu mar gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu Dan gu takarui' gu mar gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu Aser gu suudai' gu mar gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu chuukug gu jodai' gu mar gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu Gad gu jodai' gu mar gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chichio'ñ gu Moisees bhañ gu oi'ñga'n gu oidha'; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt gu mar gu chuukug jix dhaas gu Moisees gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Josuee.
Jano' ba' bhañ gu Moisees gu oi'ñga'n gu oidha' gu Kanaan tu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu ux saagi'ñ jix tɨ'ɨ gu kavɨk.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu oidha' gu ñi'ook jix duñia'; gio ba' gu ja'tkam jix daa tu' jix kavɨk jix bhai'x tu' gu jodai' jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu oidha' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' jix bhai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' jɨ'dɨlh jix duñia' tu' vaak zel gu bhóogɨt.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook ka't gu jodai' tu' gu jodai' gu takarui' tu' cham tu'x jai'ch cham gu u'u; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' gu i'bhɨ gu oi'ñga'n; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook ka't gu ñi'ook tumiiñku gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ jix duñia' gu oidha' dɨr oidha' jix gaki gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm gu suudai' baakɨk gu bhóogɨt.

Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu ux saagi'ñ tɨɨtɨs bɨɨx ka'm gu ebroon; gio ba' mi'p gu oi'ñga'n gu ux gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu ma'nkam gu vaak; mi' dhɨr gu ebroon ka't gu jodai' kɨɨv gu takarui' va'k gu bhóogɨt gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' bɨɨx ka'm gu jodai' gu Eskol gu ñi'ook gu suudai' bɨɨx gu ja'tkam gu suudai' aichdhak gook gu oi'ñga'n gu takarui' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jup tɨɨt mii' dhɨr pai' gu bhóogɨt gu ux gu ja'tkam jix duñia' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' suulh gu oi'ñga'n gu oidha' gu maa'nkar oo'm gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' tɨɨtɨs gu Moisees gu Aaroon bɨx gu takarui' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel oidha' jix gaki jix duñia' gu ñi'ook jix maa gu suudai' bɨx gu takarui' jix duñia' gu i'bhɨ gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gui'p; gio ba' no'ch gu jodai' gu oidha' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu takarui' bii'm suudai' na jix bhai'; mi' dhɨr dhi' gu i'bhɨ.
Gu' gu' gu ja'tkam jix daa mii' dhɨr gu oidha' jix kavɨk jɨ'dɨlh gu bhóogɨt jix kavɨk; gio ba' gio gu chuukug gu ma'nkam gu vaak.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu oi'ñga'n gu oidha' saagi'ñ; gio ba' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook xoi'kam gu bhóogɨt gu kavɨk; mi' dhɨr gu Kananeo gu oi'ñga'n ju'ñdharan gu gɨ' suudai' gu vaak gu Jordaan.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Kaleb jix duu gu chuukug gu ja'tkam vupui bhaan gu Moisees; gio ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu jodai'; na gu oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt.
Gu' gu' gu chichio'ñ jix tɨ'ɨ bɨɨx gui'p; gio ba' cham gu bhóogɨt jix tɨ'ɨ bhaan mii' dhɨr gu ja'tkam; na gu' gu oi'ñga'n jix kavɨk no'ch.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu oidha' gu suudai' gu takarui' bham; gio ba' gu oidha' gu ux pai' gu jodai' na ba' gu takarui' pai' gu bhóogɨt jix koi; mi' dhɨr bɨx gu ja'tkam gu chuukug tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chichio'ñ jix gɨ' dhi'; jano' ba' gio gu chuukug gu jodai' gu ma'nkam gu Anak gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu jodai'; gio ba' jɨɨ'ñdhat no'ch chulhiiñdha' gu suudai' na ja'p gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' bɨx gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt jix maa jiiñak; gio ba' gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook mii' dhɨr gu tukaa'.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' bhaan gu Moisees bhaan gu Aaroon bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' jix aa' bɨx gu oi'ñga'n; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook vaak jodai gu oidha' gu Ejipto; jano' ba' dhi' oidha' jix gaki gu ñi'ook vaak jodai.
Jano' ba' gu ux gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios dhi' gu oidha' na ba' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook biiñor gu u'vɨ biiñor gu bhóogɨt ka't gu ux gu ja'tkam cham gu suudai' tutkɨ gu chuukug gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' am:―Ja'pji maa'n; gio ba' jix duu gu suudai' gu takarui' gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Moisees gu Aaroon ia'rɨ bhaan gu vupui vupui bhaan bɨx gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu Josuee gu mar gu Nun gu Kaleb gu mar gu Jepone jix duñia' gu suudai' gu takarui' gu oidha' jix duñia' jajannulhi'ñ.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook bɨx gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bham; gio ba' gu oidha' gu ux pai' gu jodai' na ba' gu takarui' gu oidha' jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios gu chuukug no'ch gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ dhi' gu oidha' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ kapbhai'; gio ba' gu oidha' gu takarui' bii'm gu ñi'ook.

Na gu' gu ux gu jodai' cham ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu takarui' gu ja'tkam gu chuukug gu oidha' na gu' chulhiiñdha' gu takarui'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' gu vaak bɨɨx no'ch gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr cham gu takarui'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' bɨx gu oi'ñga'n gu chuukug bɨɨx gu jodai; gu' gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm duuk tu' gu jodai' dhi' gu ja'tkam bɨɨx ka'm duuk cham tu' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx bɨx buimɨk gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix koi gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu bhóogɨt bhaan gu ja'tkam jix gɨ' gu oi'ñga'n jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu Moisees jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' gu bhóogɨt gu Egipkios na gu' tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix buusñi dhi' gu ja'tkam bɨɨx gu kavɨk.

Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ dhi' gu oidha'; gio ba' jix duñia' naak tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios dhi' tɨjɨɨ'ñ dhi' gu ja'tkam gu vupui gu chuukug tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios toov ka't bhaan gu tanoolh gu suudai' vupui bhaan gu vaak toov gu tukaa' gu vaak gu tai.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook koi dhi' gu ja'tkam na ja'p gu chio'ñ; gio ba' chɨbɨɨp gu oi'ñga'n naak gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n tu ñi'ook bham.
Na gu' na gu' cham gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ dhi' gu ja'tkam gu oidha' ka't gu ñi'ook jix duñia' oidha' jix gaki.
Jano' ba' jano' tu' soi'ñ ka't gu chuukug gu kavɨk gu Jawatan na ja'p tu ñi'ook bham.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu jodai' daak jix gɨ' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt cham gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook; na jix duñia' tu' na cham jir bhai' tattat bhaan gu ma'nkam bɨɨx ka'm gu tanoolh bɨɨx ka'm jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jano' gu ñi'ook dhi' gu ja'tkam bhaan gu duukam xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch na ja'p gu chuukug dhi' gu ja'tkam dɨr gu Ejipto bɨɨx ka'm.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' gu chuukug jurtu'nka' tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu' gu ñi'ook tu' gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu bhóogɨt bɨx gu oidha'.
Na bɨx jix duñia' gɇ'kamtu'nda' buimɨk gu ñi'ook gu Ejipto oidha' jix gaki jix duñia' oilhimɨk tu' mambhɨɨx mui'kim cham jix duñia' naak gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oidha' gu takarui' tattat; gio ba' cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Na gu' cham gu ñi'ook tu duukam gu Kaleb na gu' ka't gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ jix duñia' tu' gu ñi'ook tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu oidha' pai' chɨbiapui gu kai' makia' gu maa'nkar.
Jano' ba' jano' xoi'kam gu Amalekita gu Kananeo gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu xibh gu bhóogɨt oidha' jix gaki gu bhóogɨt gu gɨ' suudai' gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees gu Aaroon bham.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx ka'm duuk tu jiim dhi' gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt bhaan tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel tu' gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' gu takarui'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bhaan jix duñia' maatɨt gu bhóogɨt tu' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' dhi' oidha' jix gaki gu chuukug; gio ba' bɨx gu oi'ñga'n bhaan bɨx jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' jiix jix duñia' vaak jodai bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' tu'r cham jɨjɨkgɨm gu oidha' gu ux gu chuukug gu novɨ jix duñia' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Kaleb gu mar gu Jepone gu Josuee gu mar gu Nun.
Gu' gu' gu bhóogɨt gui'p gu ñi'ook gu ux gu ja'tkam tu' gu bhóogɨt jix maati' gu oidha' gu takarui' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' gu takarui' gu chuukug dhi' oidha' jix gaki.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ oidha' jix gaki oo'm gu takarui' jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n bɨɨx ka'm gu chuukug ka't gu jodai' oidha' jix gaki.
Jano' ba' jurtu'nka' jɨɨ'ñdhidha' gu tanoolh oo'm gu tanoolh jix duñia' gu oidha' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook oo'm gu takarui' oi'ñga' gu ux gu tanoolh; gio ba' jix maati' sɨlhka'n.
Jano' ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt bɨx dhi' gu oi'ñga'n jix maat tu' gu ñi'ook bhaan tu'; mi' dhɨr dhi' oidha' jix gaki ka't gu jodai' gu oi'ñga'n koi.
Jano' ba' gu chichio'ñ gu Moisees bhañ gu oi'ñga'n gu oidha' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu ñi'ook vaak jodai bhaan bɨx gu ñi'ook mii' dhɨr gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ gu suudai' tu ñi'ook cham bhai' gu oidha' jix koko' gu ux vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Gu' gu' gu Josuee gu mar gu Nun gu Kaleb gu mar gu Jepone jix duñia' bɨɨx gu oidha' tɨjɨɨ'ñ mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ gu suudai' gu ja'tkam gu oi'ñga'n gu oidha'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees dhi' tu'x bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu ja'tkam jix duñia' jix jai'.
Jano' ba' jix búup gu ux gu xibh jix tɨ'ɨ gu ux gu kavɨk bham; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt na ba' jix tɨ'ɨ pai' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' gu jodai' uañi'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees; gio ba' gu ux gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios dhi' gu suudai' gu chuukug xoi'kam.
Na gu' cham jix tɨ'ɨ na gu' gu Jawatan Dios cham tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu takarui' cham ka't gu chuukug vupui bhaan obhɨɨ'ñ.
Na gu' na gu' gu Amalekita gu Kananeo vupui bhaan gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu ñi'ook; na gu' jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n gu chuukug gu Jawatan Dios gu ux gu ñi'ook cham ka't gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook jix duñia' jix tɨ'ɨ gu ux gu kavɨk; gu' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees cham jix duñia' tɨjɨɨ'ñ yooxi'.
Jano' ba' jix dhaav gu Amalekita gu Kananeo oi'ñka' mii' dhɨr gu kavɨk jix duñia' gu takarui' bɨɨx ka'm gu orma.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu takarui'; na pai' dhuuk gu oi'ñga'n kia'mi'ñ gu oidha' gu ñi'ook tu' gu chuukug.

Jano' ba' xoi'kam gu maa'nkar gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios maa'nkar tai bhaan gu maa'nkar gu ux gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tasi' aagak na ba' duñia' gu ñi'ook gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu Jawatan Dios gu jodai' kakneer.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu jodai' gu maa'nkar gu Jawatan Dios gu bhóogɨt gu ux gu o'o gu ñi'ook gu Epa gu chuukug gu vaak gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu ñi'ook baasɨ'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨ'ñdhatu'.
Jano' ba' suudai' u'va na ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' gu jodai' gu ñi'ook baasɨ'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai' maa'nkar tai bhaan gu maa'nkar gu ux mar kaneer.
Jano' ba' gu ux gu ñi'ook jix duu gu o'o gook gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu vaak gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu chuukug gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨ'ñdhatu'.
Jano' ba' suudai' u'va na ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' gu jodai' gu chuukug gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu Jawatan Dios.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook maa'nkar tai bhaan gu maa'nkar gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tasi' gu chuukug gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu o'o vaik gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu vaak gu ñi'ook bɨɨx tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨ'ñdhatu'.
Jano' ba' suudai' u'va na ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' gu jodai' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu maa'nkar gu vaak na jix bhai' gu ñi'ook gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' bɨɨx gu vaakax gu ñi'ook mar kaneer kakneer gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jurtu'nka' jɨɨ'ñdhidha' jix duu bɨɨx maa'n bhaan jɨɨ'ñdhidha'.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu chuukug jix duñia' dhi' tu'x na ba' gu bhóogɨt gu maa'nkar gu vaak na jix bhai' gu ñi'ook gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu Jawatan Dios.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook ja'tkam mii' dhɨr no'x tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu maa'nkar gu vaak na jix bhai' gu ñi'ook gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p gu ñi'ook xoi'kam jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' ñi'ook kavɨk jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' ja'tkam mii' dhɨr bɨɨx gu ñi'ook; gio ba' ñi'ook kavɨk ka't gu chuukug gu ux gu bhóogɨt; mi' dhɨr na ja'p gu ñi'ook ka't jix duñia' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu takarui'; na pai' dhuuk gu oi'ñga'n kia'mi'ñ gu oidha' tu' gu jodai'.
Na pai' dhuuk ka't na pai' dhuuk jugi gu takarui' gu oidha' gu bhóogɨt gu maa'nkar gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' maa'n gu takarui' gu bhóogɨt gu takarui' gu maa'nkar; gio ba' na ja'p gu maa'nkar ka't gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' gu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu maa'nkar gu ux gu ma'nkam.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu chuukug cham xoi'kam bɨx dhi' ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' bɨx tu'x gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix aa'ñdhix gu ux gu novɨ gu Moisees dɨr gu tanoolh gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix jix duñia' gu ux gu bhóogɨt.

Jano' ba' ka't tu' uañi'ñ ka't gu ñi'ook gu ux gu vaak bɨɨx gu takarui' gu ñi'ook bɨx gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu vaak gu ux maa'nkar tai bhaan gu ñi'ook gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu o'o gu vaak na jix bhai' jurtu'nka' ñi'ook na tu a'ga; gio ba' gu chio'ñ chiiw gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.

Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu ux bɨx gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; na gu' ka't gu chuukug na gu' gu vaak; mi' dhɨr gu chuukug gu maa'nkar gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu ux gu jodai'.
Na gu' ka't gu chuukug bɨx gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel ja'tkam mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ na gu' gu vaak bɨx gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' tu' gu ñi'ook gu ux gu vaak gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook oi'ñga' gu ux gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.

Na pai' dhuuk jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu ux gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n uañi'ñ gu ux gu vaak na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook gu ux gu vaak vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' ka't gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix duñia' tɨjɨɨ'ñ ñi'ook na tu a'ga jix duñia' na ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu ux gu vaak.
Gu' gu' gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n gu novɨ gu chuukug na ja'p ja'tkam mii' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia'; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam.
Na gu' na gu' jix duñia' gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix maa gu ux gu suudai' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook ka't bhaan.
Jano' ba' kua' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel oidha' jix gaki gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ gu oi'ñga'n gu u'u gu tanoolh juanda'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu u'u aichdhak gu Moisees gu Aaroon bɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas kuupa' gu ux cham ka't jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' duñia'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' jix bhai'x gu jodai' mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ; mi' dhɨr gu takarui' bɨɨx gu jodai bɨx gu ñi'ook mai' yooxi'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix buusñi gu ñi'ook mai' yooxi' jix duñia' bɨɨx gu jodai jix koi; gio ba' na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix gu Moisees.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu takarui' xoi'kam gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu oi'ñga'n jajannulhi'ñ gu ux gu ma'nkam; gio ba' gu suudai' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt.

Na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim na ba' na pai' dhuuk gu jodai' gu bhóogɨt bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios na ba' jix duñia' gu ux tu duukam; gio ba' cham gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ gu vupui gu ñi'ook.
Na ba' na ba' gu bhóogɨt xoi'kam bɨx gu ñi'ook ka't jɨɨgi'ñdham gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oidha' gu Ejipto na ba' gu suudai' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu Koree gu mar gu Isar gu mar gu Koat gu mar gu Lebii; gio ba' gu suudai' gu Abiram gu ma'nkam gu Eliab; mi' dhɨr gu on gu mar gu Pelet gu ma'nkam gu Rubeen jix bhɨɨ gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' jix búup bhaan gu Moisees bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n mambhɨɨx gu chichio'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel chiñia' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu chichio'ñ gu tɨɨgɨ'.

Jano' ba' jum daa'ñ bhaan gu Moisees gu Aaroon gui'p; na gu' gu jodai' na gu' bɨx gu ñi'ook bɨx jɨɨgi'ñdham tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook bhaan gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' na ja'p jix kai gu Moisees mi'x juu'ñ bhaan gu vupui.
Ba' jix aa' gu Koree bɨx gu oi'ñga'n bham; gio ba' gu xibh jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios chɨkka gu kutun jix bhaan jix duñia' gu chuukug; mi' dhɨr gu takarui' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' xoi'kam dhi'; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ gu chuukug gu Koree bɨx gu oi'ñga'n.

Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu tai gu suudai' gu takarui' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu xibh; gio ba' ka't gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu takarui' gu bhóogɨt ka't jix bhaan; mi' dhɨr gu jodai' dhi' gu ma'nkam gu Lebii.
Ba' jix aa' gu oi'ñga'n gu Moisees gu Koree; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jano' gu ma'nkam gu Lebii.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel ka't gu vaak gu ñi'ook gu Israeel gu jodai' gu takarui' na ba' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ vupui bhaan gu ñi'ook na ba' gu vaak na jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' jix duu tu' gu ñi'ook tu' bɨx xibhɨk gu ma'nkam gu Lebii bɨndak; na ba' gu takarui' gio jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan.
Na ba' gu ux gu jodai' tu' bɨx gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' gu Aaroon gu ñi'ook na ba' bhaan vaak jodai.
Jano' ba' bhañ gu Moisees tɨɨt gu Dataan gu Abiram gu ma'nkam gu Eliab; gu' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr cham gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook cham tu'x jai'ch gu ñi'ook gu kutun gu oidha' gu oi'ñga'n bii'm gu ñi'ook na ba' gu oi'ñga'n koi oidha' jix gaki gu ñi'ook gio tu' gu takarui' no'ch jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' tu' gu suudai' gu jodai' tu' gu oidha' gu oi'ñga'n bii'm gu ñi'ook tu' jix maa dɨppɨr oi'ñga'n oidha' u'va; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt gu vupui dhi' ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ cham jix tɨ'ɨ.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Moisees bhaam gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham gu ñi'ook gu o'o; mi' dhɨr tu' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook jix bhɨɨ tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook cham bhai'.
Ba' jix aa' mi' dhɨr gu Moisees gu Koree; gio ba' tu' bɨx gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' gu xibh vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr tu' gu Aaroon.

Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ maa'n vaak na jix bhaan gu suudai' gu takarui' jix duñia' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios maa'n vaak na jix bhaan; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n mambhɨɨx gu chuukug; mi' dhɨr tu' gio gu Aaroon maa'n bɨɨx vaak na jix bhaan.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ maa'n vaak na jix bhaan jix dhaas gu tai mi'x juu'ñ gu takarui' jix dhaas ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut bɨɨx gu Moisees gu Aaroon.
Jano' ba' tu' gu Koree ka't gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n bhaan bɨx gu ñi'ook ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut; gio ba' jano' ba' gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Jawatan Dios jix ñi'ñ bɨx gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees gu Aaroon bham.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ dhi' gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' mi'x juu'ñ bhaan gu vupui gui'p; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ bɨx gu chuukug cham gu chio'ñ jix duñia' tu' gu suudai' tu' bhaan bɨx gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' gu abla gu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt vaak zel gu Koree gu Dataan gu Abiram.
Jano' ba' gu Moisees jix búup ka't gu Dataan gu Abiram; gio ba' daraa gu Israeel jix bɨɨx duu gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jano' vaak zel dhi' ja'tkam jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ cham gu chuukug matgɨm gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu jodai' gu ñi'ook cham gu ñi'ook bɨx uañi'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' vaak zel gu Koree gu Dataan gu Abiram gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' gu Dataan gu Abiram moor jix dhaas kiki'ñgob vaak zel bɨɨx gu u'vɨ gu ma'nkam gu bhóogɨt.
Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees; gio ba' dhi' jix maati' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ba' gu jodai' bɨx dhi' tu'x; na cham gu i'ii'ñ gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' tu' na ja'p suulhgidha' bɨx gu chichio'ñ gu ñi'ook suulhgia' tu' ka't gu chuukug bɨx gu chichio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios cham bhañ.

Gu' gu' tu' gu Jawatan Dios gu oi'ñga'n gu ja'tkam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oidha' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chin gu ñi'ook bɨɨx bɨx tu'x jix duñia' ko'iix jix dhaam suudai' jano' ba' jix maati' dhi' ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' ka't a'gidhimɨk ñiokda' bɨx dhi' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu oidha' ka't bɨtaa'n.
Jano' ba' jix kupi'ook gu oidha' gu chin jix duñia' gu vaak bɨx gu chichio'ñ gu Koree bɨx gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx bɨx ko'kmarak jix dhaav ko'iix jix dhaam suudai' gu bhóogɨt gu oidha' jix koi tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu Israeel mi'p gu bhóogɨt jiboi'ññor gu ñi'ook; na gu' am:―Ja'pji; mi' dhɨr cham gu ñi'ook gio gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' jix buus gu tai gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n mambhɨɨx gu chichio'ñ gu bhóogɨt gu takarui'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' tu' gu Eleasar gu mar gu Aaroon jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix bhɨɨ gu chuukug tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaak gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu tai; na gu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.

Jano' ba' gu chuukug dhi' ja'tkam u'ua'tulhdhix bhaan gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' jix duu gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu takarui' na ba' gu chuukug jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; na gu' jix duñia' bɨɨx vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; jano' ba' ka't gu ux nɨi'ñchudat gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Eleasar jix bhɨɨ gu chuukug gu jodai' na jix uam bɨɨx gu takarui' gu suudai'; gio ba' jix duñia' na ba' gu chuukug jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.

Na gu' gu oi'ñga'n gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu oi'ñga'n gu tanoolh cham ka't gu kai' gu Aaroon gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt gu takarui' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios na gu' cham ka't na ja'p gu Koree na ja'p gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' bhaan jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu ux gu novɨ gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' gu tanoolh buimgidhak bɨx gu takarui' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel vaak jodai bhaan gu Moisees gu Aaroon bham; gio ba' gu takarui' jix duñia' jix koi gu ja'tkam gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' ka't na ja'p jum daa'ñ gu takarui' bhaan gu Moisees gu Aaroon jix duñia' bhaan vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut gu suudai' toov ka't jix bhaan dhaas jix ñi'ñ gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs gu Moisees gu Aaroon vupui bhaan vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ dhi' gu takarui' gu chuukug gu suudai'; gio ba' mi'x juu'ñ bhaan gu jodai'.

Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees gu Aaroon; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ vaak na jix bhaan gu takarui' gu tai jodai maa'nkar Jawatan bhaan gu takarui' gu ñi'ook tu' jootom gu takarui' gu vupui gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux; na gu' i'iich tu' gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios; jano' ba' jix koi tu' kua'da'.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Aaroon vaak na jix bhaan na ja'p gu Moisees dai'bus tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu takarui'; gio ba' gu suudai' jix koi ka't kua'da' gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr jix dhaas gu ñi'ook jix duu gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas tɨjɨɨ'ñ koko'kam ko'iix; gio ba' jix utu'ñ jix koi.
Jano' ba' jix koko' mii' dhɨr jix koi jix bɨɨx duu gu ñi'ook mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu chuukug cham koko'kam gu ux gu chuukug gu Koree.
Na pai' dhuuk mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu Aaroon gu Moisees ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut na pai' dhuuk jix koi ka't jix duñia'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix bhɨɨ gu ux gu vaak tattat gu bhóogɨt chiñia' gu kutun gu oi'ñga'n jurtu'nka' gu vaak tattat; gio ba' gu o'o gu tɨɨgɨ' maa'n bhaan gu ux.
Jano' ba' gu o'o gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Aaroon bhaan gu ux gu Lebii; na gu' mo'o ja'tkam vaak tattat gu oi'ñga'n gu ux.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut vupui bhaan chuut pai' tu' gu jodai' gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu chio'ñ tu' gu takarui' gu ux gu suudai'; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' bhaan tu' gu takarui' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bɨɨx vaak jodai bhaan gu takarui'.

Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bɨx chiñia' jix maa gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu ux gu vaak tattat gu ux bɨx gu kutun gu oi'ñga'n; mi' dhɨr gu ux gu Aaroon ka't tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu Moisees jix dhaas gu oi'ñga'n vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.

Jano' ba' ka't gu tanoolh buimgidhak suudai' u'va gu Moisees vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut; gio ba' gu suudai' gu ux gu Aaroon gu vaak gu Lebii ka't gu suudai' baas gu chuukug gu maa'nkar gu takarui' gu oi'ñga'n gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix buusñi gu Moisees gu bhóogɨt gu oi'ñga'n vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu bhóogɨt gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' gu takarui' jix duñia' jix bhɨɨ maa'n gu ux.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt gu ux gu Aaroon vupui bhaan chuut na ba' nukadham gu ux nɨi'ñchudat gu ma'nkam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; na gu' jix duu gu suudai' gu takarui' bhaan tu' na gu' cham gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Moisees; gio ba' na ja'p jix aa'ñdhix gu Jawatan Dios jix duu.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel tu ñi'ook gu Moisees bham; gio ba' gu suudai' no'ch gu'ch koko'kam gu ñi'ook gu'ch bɨx no'ch gu'ch gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' no'x gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios koi; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix koi bɨx.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Aaroon; gio ba' tu' gu ma'nkam gu vaak gu taat bɨndak jix duñia' uañi'ñ xidhuu; mi' dhɨr tu' gu ma'nkam bɨndak jix duñia' uañi'ñ jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam gio bopxi'ñ gu Lebii bopxi'ñ gu taat tu jiim gu chuukug tu' jum daa'ñ bɨndak tu' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' gu ma'nkam bɨndak gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.
Jano' ba' nukadham tu' gu vaak gu chuukug bɨx vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan; na gu' gu' cham jix duñia' gu ux jɨɨgi'ñdham tu' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan na gu' cham gu ñi'ook gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' gu ux bɨndak jix duñia' gu chuukug vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut bɨx gu bhóogɨt vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu tanoolh tu' gu chuukug bhaan.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' jix nukadham xidhuu jix nukadham jodai maa'nkar Jawatan na ba' cham ka't gu oi'ñga'n daak bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Na gu' na gu' gu suudai' tu' jix bhɨɨ xibhɨk gu Lebitas tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu duukam gu Jawatan Dios na ba' gu suudai' gu takarui' vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.

Gu' gu' tu' gu ma'nkam bɨndak nukadham jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan bɨx gu chuukug jodai maa'nkar Jawatan jix duñia' gu ñi'ook jix duñia'; gio ba' tu' jix maa gu duukam gu bhóogɨt jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan; mi' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ koi.

Ba' jix aa' gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan Dios gu Aaroon; gio ba' gu Miren tu' jix maa gio jix nukadham maa'nkar na jix maa; mi' dhɨr bɨx tu'x gu jodai' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel tu' jix maa gu ux gu oi'ñga'n gu kutun gu ma'nkam gu ux ñi'ook kavɨk gu chuukug.

Jano' ba' dhi' ka't gu oi'ñga'n gu maa'nkar tu'x jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu chuukug gu tai; gio ba' bɨx gu maa'nkar bɨx gu o'o gu kutun bɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux uañi'ñ bɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt abhaar na ba' tu' na ba' gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' xidhuu jugi; gio ba' bɨx gu chio'ñ jugi; mi' dhɨr gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ abhaar ka't na ba' tu'.

Jano' ba' dhi' gio ka't gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' gu maa'nkar gu jodai' juana' bɨx maa'nkar na jix maa gu jodai' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix maa tu' gu ma'nkam ma'nkam u'uuvɨ bɨndak gu ux ñi'ook kavɨk gu chuukug; mi' dhɨr bɨx na jix bhai' gu vaak jugi.
Jano' ba' bɨ'ñdhatu' gu bhóogɨt tiriik bɨx gu oi'ñga'n gu tasi' gu takarui' gu i'ii'ñ jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa.
Jano' ba' gu ux na tu ibai' bɨx tu'x gu oidha' gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu jodai'; gio ba' bɨx na jix bhai' gu vaak jugi.
Jano' ba' bɨx jix bhaan gu ux gu tasi' gu Israeel ka't gu oi'ñga'n.

Jano' ba' bɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu takarui' bɨx gu chuukug gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios gu chichio'ñ na ja'p gu vaakax ka't gu oi'ñga'n; gu' bɨx tu jiim maa'nkam mar gu chio'ñ; mi' dhɨr gio jix duu tu jiim maa'nkam mar gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n ñaanbi'.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' jix duu gu chuukug gu kutun jurtu'nka' gu jodai' gu ux u'uuk jixchamaam gu bhóogɨt xidhuu gu ñi'ook gu vaak.

Gu' gu' maa'nkam mar gu ñi'ook maa'nkam mar kaneer maa'nkam mar gu ñi'ook cham gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; mi' dhɨr gu ɨ'ɨr gu chuukug bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar gu vaak na jix bhai' gu ñi'ook gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug ka't gu suudai'; gio ba' na ja'p baaso gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ja'p gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu jiim ka't gu suudai'.

Jano' ba' bɨx maa'nkar na jix maa gu oi'ñga'n tu'x jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu takarui' jix maa na ba' tu' na ba' gu ma'nkam na ba' ma'nkam u'uuvɨ bɨndak gu ux ñi'ook kavɨk gu chuukug; gio ba' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu ñi'ook gu chuukug vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios na ba' tu' na ba' gu kai' bɨndak.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Aaroon; gio ba' gu oidha' cham gu oi'ñga'n gu maa'nkar tu' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oi'ñga'n baasɨ'n; mi' dhɨr gu Yo jix duñia' baasɨ'n gu maa'nkar tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Na gu' gu suudai' tu' jix maa gu ma'nkam gu Lebii bɨx boosgi gu Israeel gu ux gu maa'nkar gu ux gu takarui' na gu' tu jiim gu takarui' vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.
Na gu' cham jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n gu ma'nkam gu Israeel vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut na gu' cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ uañi'ñ gu ux gu ñi'ook.

Gu' gu' gu Lebitas jix duu gu bhóogɨt vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut jix duñia' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' ñi'ook kavɨk gu chuukug gu ux oidha' maa'nkar; mi' dhɨr cham gu bhóogɨt gu maa'nkar tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.

Na gu' na gu' gu Lebitas jix maa gu ux gu maa'nkar boosgi gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios gu maa'nkar; gio ba' gu ux tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel cham gu bhóogɨt gu maa'nkar.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu Lebitas daipu'; na pai' dhuuk jix bhɨɨ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel boosgi jix maa gu ux gu maa'nkar gu ñi'ook gu o'o gu maa'nkar gu suudai' gu Jawatan Dios mambhɨɨx boosgi.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar na ja'p kai'ñ ka't na ja'p gu suudai' gu chuukug.

Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gio gu takarui' gu maa'nkar gu Jawatan Dios bɨx boosgi gu oi'ñga'n dho'ñchidhak gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' jix duñia' gu takarui' gu maa'nkar gu Jawatan Dios gu Aaroon jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' bɨx juana' gu bhóogɨt bɨx gu maa'nkar gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' bɨx tutkɨ gu bhóogɨt gu maa'nkar tu' gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' daipu'; na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook tutkɨ ka't jix duñia' gu Lebitas gu ux gu i'bhɨ ka't na ja'p gu i'bhɨ gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' jugi gu ñi'ook pai' gu ñi'ook ja'tkam vaak; na gu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux gu takarui' vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu takarui' gu oi'ñga'n gu suudai' gu i'ii'ñ tutkɨ gu kutun cham jix duñia' gu ux gu i'ii'ñ uañi'ñ; gio ba' cham jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n tu'x jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel cham koi.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees gu Aaroon bham.

Jano' ba' dhi' jir bɨx bhai' ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu suudai' bham; gio ba' tu' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu jodai' cham ka't uañi'ñ bhaan cham ka't gu ñi'ook gu tasi'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Eleasar jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan mai' yooxi' jix duñia' gu tasi' gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Eleasar jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu ɨ'ɨr bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' bhaan gu ñi'ook vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut bɨɨx gu ɨ'ɨr kɨɨv mui'kim.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu vupui; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu ɨ'ɨr bɨɨx gu takarui' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu oi'ñga'n gɨ' u'u kavɨk gu ñi'ook tu jiim jix duñia' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tai gu chuukug gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix duñia' jajannulhi'ñ jix duñia' gio gu chuukug bɨɨx gu suudai' mi' dhɨr jix duñia' vaak ja'tkam; gio ba' ka't ñaanbi' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' jajannulhi'ñ gu suudai' gio jix duñia' gu suudai' gu chuukug ka't ñaanbi' bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai.
Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ na jix bhai' gu ñi'ook maatai gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt mai' yooxi' pai' gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel na ba' gu suudai'; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' maatai gu ñi'ook jix duñia' jajannulhi'ñ ka't ñaanbi' bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai; gio ba' ka't gu ma'nkam gu Israeel ja'tkam mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux ñi'ook kavɨk gu chuukug.
Na gu suudai' jix koi no'x gu ñi'ook gu jodai' kɨɨv gu tanoolh ka't ñaanbi'.
Jano' ba' dhi' jix duñia' vaik gu tanoolh bɨɨx gu chuukug gu suudai' kɨɨv gu tanoolh ka't na jix bhai'; gio ba' tu' vaik gu tanoolh cham gu jodai' cham ka't kɨɨv gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' no'x gu suudai' jix koi gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ jix koi cham gu jodai' vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia'; gio ba' mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Israeel; na gu' gu suudai' cham ka't jix duñia' bhaan ñaanbi' ka't; jano' ba' gu vaak ka't bhaan.
Na pai' dhuuk dhi' ñi'ook na tu a'ga na ba' na pai' dhuuk oi'ñdha' gu jodai' vaak zel; gio ba' no'x tɨjɨɨ'ñ vaak zel bɨx ka't ñaanbi' kɨɨv gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ux jix kupi'ook bhaan cham ka't gu jodai' xoi'kam gu takarui' ka't ñaanbi'.
Jano' ba' no'x gu suudai' jix koi gu ñi'ook bhaan gu vupui yooxi' jix koi o'o gu ja'tkam tukga'n kɨɨv gu tanoolh ka't ñaanbi'.
Jano' ba' na ba' ñaanbi' jix bhɨɨ maatai vaak na jix bhaan gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ mi'x juu'ñ bhaan gu suudai' gu tai gu ux.
Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ na jix bhai' jix bhɨɨ gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu suudai' jix duñia' bhaan vaak zel bhaan bɨx gu oi'ñga'n bhaan gu bhóogɨt bhaan mii' dhɨr ka't dhaa o'o gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix koi tukga'n.
Jano' ba' na jix bhai' jix duñia' bhaan ñaanbi' vaik kɨɨv gu tanoolh; na pai' dhuuk gu oi'ñga'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tanoolh kɨɨv jix duñia' jajannulhi'ñ jix duñia' bɨɨx gu suudai' ka't gu xumai.

Na gu' ka't ñaanbi' cham gu jodai' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu takarui' na gu' jix duñia' vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham ka't jix duñia' bhaan gu suudai'; mi' dhɨr ñaanbi'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu ux ñi'ook kavɨk gu chuukug; gio ba' gio gu jodai' gu suudai' jix duñia' jajannulhi'ñ; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' ka't ñaanbi' bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai.
Jano' ba' bɨx ñaanbi' gu suudai' ka't ñaanbi'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' ka't gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bɨx gu ñi'ook oidha' jix gaki gu Sin gu takarui' maa'n jix duñia' gu ja'tkam gu Kades; gio ba' jix koi gu Mariia ka't gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' na ja'p cham gu takarui' gu suudai' na ba' gu ñi'ook jum daa'ñ bhaan gu Moisees gu Aaroon.
Jano' ba' jix suudai' duu gu ja'tkam bɨɨx gu Moisees tu ñi'ook bham; na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook no'ch gu chuukug jix koi na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' xibhɨk gu ja'tkam vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu ux gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n jix ai gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios dhi' oidha' jix gaki na ba' vaak jodai no'ch gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu vaakax.
Jano' ba' gu ux gu ñi'ook jix tɨ'ɨ gu Ejipto na ba' gu chuukug dhi' cham bhai' pai' cham pai' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu suudai' tu' gu maa'nkar; gio ba' tu' gu suudai' na ba' i'i.
Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu Moisees gu Aaroon vupui bhaan gu takarui' ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut mi'x juu'ñ bhaan gu vupui; gio ba' gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Jawatan Dios jix ñi'ñ bhaan.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.

Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu ux gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook tu' gu Aaroon xibhɨk tu ñi'ook gu jodai' na jix uam gu vupui; gio ba' maa'n gu suudai' jix buusñi gu suudai' gu jodai' na jix uam maa'n i'i gu ñi'ook gu vaakax.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Moisees jix bhɨɨ gu ux vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p jix aa'ñdhix.
Ba' jix aa' jum daa'ñ gu Moisees gu Aaroon gu takarui' vupui bhaan gu jodai' na jix uam; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jano' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; mi' dhɨr gu jodai' bhaan jix buus gu suudai' dhi' gu jodai' na jix uam.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Moisees gu novɨ naaka'n gu jodai' na jix uam bɨɨx gu ux gook mui'kim; gio ba' moor mumua'da' gu suudai' jix i'i gu ñi'ook gu vaakax.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees gu Aaroon; na gu' cham jɨɨ'ñ tu' na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vupui gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu ñi'ook gu jodai' cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ dhi' gu takarui' gu oidha' jix maa.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu suudai' gu takarui' gu ux gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bɨɨx gu Jawatan Dios jix bhaan duu.
Jano' ba' bhañ gu Moisees gu chuukug gu gɨ'kora' gu Edom dɨr gu Kades; gio ba' tu ñi'ook gu Israeel xibhɨk; mi' dhɨr tu' gu jodai' bɨx tu jiim tu' tɨbiap.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook taata'n tattat jix dhaav gu Ejipto gu takarui' gu Ejipto jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Egipkios jix duñia' taata'n tattat.
Jano' ba' duuñ gu Jawatan Dios jix kai gu kutun gu ñi'ook bhañ nobii'ñ jix buusñi gu Ejipto; gio ba' gu suudai' dhi' gu Kades kiicham gu ñi'ook gu takarui'.

Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu oidha'; gio ba' cham gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook tu juan tu' gu ñi'ook oidha' u'va tu' i'i gu suudai' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt vaak ja'tkam gu takarui' cham gu oi'ñga'n kɨɨ'n tu' gu jodai' bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Edom jix aa'; gio ba' cham gu suudai' gu ux gu oi'ñga'n gu jodai' bhaan tu' gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gui'p; gio ba' gu ux gu bhóogɨt bia'kat gu takarui'; mi' dhɨr tu' gu jodai' gu suudai' tu' gu suudai' u'uuk; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook cham bhaan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai' gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' cham gu suudai'; mi' dhɨr jix buus gu Edom bhaan bɨɨx jix jai' gu ja'tkam gu novɨ jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' cham gu oi'ñga'n gu Edom mi'x dhaas gu ñi'ook gu Israeel gu ux gu ñi'ook jix ai'chdhix gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu Kades gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bɨx mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook tɨɨtɨs gu kavɨk gu or.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees gu Aaroon gu kavɨk gu or gu takarui' gu oidha' gu Edom bham.
Jano' ba' gu Aaroon ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam; na gu' cham jix duñia' gu oidha' tu' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel na gu' jix bɨɨx duu gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Aaroon gu Eleasar gu mar tu jiim jix tɨ'ɨ gu kavɨk gu or.
Jano' ba' gu vupui cham kutun gu Aaroon jajannulhi'ñ jix duñia' gu Eleasar gu mar; na gu' gu Aaroon ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam koi.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Moisees na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix; gio ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu kavɨk gu or gu vupui bɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Moisees cham kutun gu Aaroon jajannulhi'ñ jix duñia' gu Eleasar gu mar; gio ba' gu Aaroon jix koi gu ux gu kavɨk; mi' dhɨr gu Moisees gu Eleasar jix dhaav gu kavɨk.
Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Aaroon ka't jix koi jix duu gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh bɨx gu jodai' gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' tɨiñ gu Kananeo gu gɨ'kora' gu Arad jix daa saagi'ñ gu jodai' gu Israeel gu ux gu bhóogɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux bɨɨx gu Israeel jix bhɨɨ gu ja'tkam.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Israeel jix duu gu tasi' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ kapbhai' dhi' gu ja'tkam gu novɨ tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jɨ'dɨlh.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Israeel do'ñcho gu Kananeo jix duñia' jɨ'dɨlh; gio ba' jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' mii' dhɨr pai' gu orma.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu kavɨk gu or gu bhóogɨt gu gɨ' suudai' gu ñi'ook na ba' gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu Edom; gio ba' jix duñia' gu takarui' gu ja'tkam gu ux gu bhóogɨt.

Ba' jix aa' gu ja'tkam bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' gu ux gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n jix tɨ'ɨ gu Ejipto na ba' vaak jodai dhi' oidha' jix gaki tu' cham tu'x jai'ch gu takarui' tu' gu suudai' gu kutun gu i'ii'ñ juraa'n gu suudai' dhi' gu takarui' jix bhai'x gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios bhañ tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam gu ko'oi gu vaak gu maa'nkar gu ja'tkam; gio ba' jix koi jix jai' gu ja'tkam gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu ja'tkam suudai' u'va gu Moisees gui'p; gio ba' uañi'ñ gu jodai' gu ux a'ga tu ñi'ook bhaan gu Jawatan Dios bhaan tu'; mi' dhɨr gu chuukug gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook no'ch dhi' gu ko'oi; jano' ba' gu Moisees jix duñia' gu ux gu ja'tkam.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' gu chuukug gu ko'oi gu vaak jix dhaas bhaan gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr ka't no'x ka't jix koi gu takarui' ii'mdagaram.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu Moisees gu ko'oi gu jodai' na jix uam jix dhaas bhaan gu ñi'ook; na pai' dhuuk ka't na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook gu ko'oi jix koi oi'ñdha' jix duñia' gu ko'oi gu jodai' na jix uam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix duñia' yooxi' gu Obot.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu Obot jix duñia' gu ja'tkam oidha' jix gaki vupui bhaan gu Moab gu jodai' gu tas.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug jix duñia' gu suudai' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' baasɨ'n gu Arnoon oidha' jix gaki gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu Amorreo; na gu' gu Arnoon gu ñi'ook gu Moab tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Moab gu Amorreo.
Na ba' gu ux gu jodai' tu ñi'ook u'uan gu chuukug gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix duu gu gɨ' suudai' gu ñi'ook gu jodai' gu Arnoon.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' gu jodai' tu' gu ñi'ook gu Ar gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu Moab.
Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs gu Beer; gio ba' dhi' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix aa' gu Moisees; mi' dhɨr gu kutun gu ja'tkam gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jiiñ gu Israeel dhi' gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr tɨ'ya'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt chiñia' gu ja'tkam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx gu chuukug; mi' dhɨr oidha' jix gaki tɨɨtɨs gu Matana.
Jano' ba' gu Matana gu Naaliel; gio ba' gu Naaliel gu Bamot.
Jano' ba' gu Bamot gu suudai' vaak ja'tkam gu Moab gu ux gu Pisga tu jiim gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' bhañ gu Israeel gu chuukug gu kutun gu gɨ'kora' gu Amorreos bham.

Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu ux gu oidha'; gio ba' cham gu takarui' gu ux tu juan tu' gu ux oidha' u'va; mi' dhɨr cham i'i gu suudai' gu ñi'ook; jano' ba' gu ux gu bhóogɨt vaak ja'tkam gu takarui' bɨɨx ka'm gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook.

Gu' gu' gu kutun cham mi'x dhaas gu ñi'ook gu Israeel gu ux gu ñi'ook; gio ba' va'k jum daa'ñ gu kutun bɨx gu ja'tkam jix buus bhaan gu Israeel oidha' jix gaki; mi' dhɨr suudai' u'va gu Jaas gu ux bhaan gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' naaka'n gu Israeel gu bhóogɨt gu kuchii jix bhɨɨ gu oidha' dɨr gu Arnoon bɨɨx ka'm gu Jabok bɨɨx ka'm gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon; na gu' gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon ka't jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Israeel bɨx dhi' jɨ'dɨlh; gio ba' jix daa gu Israeel bɨx jɨ'dɨlh gu Amorreo gu esboon bɨx taañpu'.
Na gu' na gu' gu esboon ka't kiicham gu kutun gu gɨ'kora' gu Amorreos; gio ba' ka't jix duñia' bhɨɨ'ñdham va'k bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu Moab jix bhɨɨ gu suudai' bɨx gu oidha' bɨɨx ka'm gu Arnoon.
Na ba' gu ux gu jodai' tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt gu esboon gu suudai' gu jodai' kiicham gu kutun.
Na gu tai jix buus gu esboon mɨmɨim kiicham gu kutun jix duñia' gu Ar gu Moab gu Jawatan gu oi'ñga'n gu Arnoon.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu' gu Moab gu suudai' gu ja'tkam gu takarui'; gio ba' jix dhaas gu ma'nkam gu takarui' ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu ux gu kutun gu gɨ'kora' gu Amorreos.
Gu' gu' gu takarui' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'; gio ba' jix duñia' gu esboon bɨɨx ka'm gu Diboon gu takarui' bɨɨx ka'm gu Nopa gu Medeba.
Jano' ba' jix daa gu Israeel gu oidha' gu Amorreo.
Jano' ba' bhañ gu Moisees gu oi'ñga'n gu Jaser; gio ba' gu ñi'ook taañpu' mi'x juu'ñ gu Amorreo ka't.
Jano' ba' suulh jix tɨ'ɨ gu bhóogɨt gu Basaan jix buus bhaan gu Og gu gɨ'kora' gu Basaan bɨx gu ja'tkam na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Edrei.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ɨɨbhi'ñ gu novɨ jix maa bɨx gu ja'tkam gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr jix duu na ja'p gu oi'ñga'n gu kutun gu gɨ'kora' gu Amorreos jix daa gu esboon.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ma'nkam bɨx gu ja'tkam cham gu suudai' maa'n gu vupui gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix duñia' vaak ja'tkam gu Moab dhi' baasɨ'n gu Jordaan gu Jerikoo.
Jano' ba' jix ñi' gu Balak gu mar gu Sippor bɨx gu Israeel ka't gu ñi'ook gu Amorreo.
Jano' ba' gu Moab jix duñia' jix jai' kuiñcha gu ja'tkam ka't jix jai'; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Moab kuiñcha gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.

Ba' jix aa' gu Moab daraa gu Madiaan; gio ba' jano' jix duñia' dhi' gu ja'tkam bɨx gu oi'ñga'n gu suudai' na ja'p jix duñia' gu vaakax gu ñi'ook yooxi'; mi' dhɨr gu Balak gu mar gu Sippor ka't jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Moab.

Na ba' gu ux gu jodai' bhañ gu takarui' gu Balaam gu mar gu Beor gu Petor ju'ñdharan gɨ' suudai' jiim gu oidha' gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam na ba' mɨmɨim bham; gio ba' gu ja'tkam tu' gu ñi'ook gu Ejipto gu suudai' jix duñia' gu vupui gu oidha' jix daa vupui bhaan tu'.
