Na gu' gu kutun jano' tu' soi'ñ gu ñi'ook dhi' gu ja'tkam na gu' gu oi'ñga'n jix kavɨk tu'; gio ba' gu kutun gu oi'ñga'n tu' gu ñi'ook mi'x juu'ñ gu oidha'; na tu' gu oi'ñga'n ka't gu takarui' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ka't gu kutun.
Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu daraa gu Moab daraa gu Madiaan bɨɨx gu suudai' gu novɨ jix duñia' gu Balaam gui'p gu ñi'ook gu Balak.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' jix duñia' dhi' gu tukaa' tu' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr chiñia' gu Moab jix duñia' bɨɨx gu Balaam.
Ba' jix aa' suudai' u'va gu Jawatan Dios gu Balaam; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu chichio'ñ dhi' ja'tkam bɨndak.
Jano' ba' gu Balaam jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Balak gu mar gu Sippor gu gɨ'kora' gu Moab tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' bham.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' dhi' gu ja'tkam tu' gu ñi'ook gu Ejipto jix duñia' gu vupui gu oidha'; gio ba' gu kutun jano' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu kutun gu oi'ñga'n gu ux bɨɨx mi'x juu'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Balaam; gio ba' cham gu ñi'ook bɨɨx tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam; na gu' gu takarui'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Balaam jix búup gu ux gu xibh chiñia' gu Balak; na gu' gu ñi'ook gu oidha' na gu' gu Jawatan Dios cham gu suudai' mi'x dhaas tu' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' chiñia' gu Moab jix búup tɨɨtɨs gu Balak gui'p; gio ba' gu Balaam cham gu oi'ñga'n jix ai bɨɨx no'ch.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Balak tɨip jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n chiñia' gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs gu Balaam gui'p; gio ba' tu ñi'ook gu Balak gu mar gu Sippor; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' cham mi'x dhaas jix ai tu'.
Na gu' na gu' cham jix duñia' tu' nɨidhat jix jai' gu bhóogɨt bɨx gu chuukug; gio ba' gu kutun jano' gu ñi'ook dhi' gu ja'tkam.

Ba' jix aa' gu Balaam tu duukam gu Balak; gio ba' gu ux gu Balak koi gu vaak gu ñi'ook jix toja jodai jix uam jodai cham gu takarui' bhaan gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios na ba' bhaan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook tu' jix gɨ'.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu jodai' jano' gu chuukug dhi' gu tukaa' na ba' tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu chuukug gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' suudai' u'va gu Jawatan Dios gu Balaam gu tukaa'; gio ba' gu Si gu bhóogɨt mɨmɨim gu chichio'ñ bamii' tu' bɨɨx; gu' cham gu ñi'ook jix duu tu' gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' gu Balaam jix búup gu ux gu xibh jix duñia' gu ñi'ook ka't bɨɨx chiñia' gu Moab.

Na gu' i'iich gu Jawatan Dios gu tai na gu' gu chuukug; gio ba' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jix dhaas gu bhóogɨt gu ux gu ñi'ook gu kutun; mi' dhɨr gu chuukug gɨ' kavɨk bhaan gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oi'ñga'n.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix ñi' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx gu kuchii cham kutun gu novɨ; gio ba' jix ai'chdhix gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu chuukug gu ux yooxi'; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' naaka'n gu Balaam gu ñi'ook na ba' jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt.
Gu' gu' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jix dhaas gu chuukug oidha' u'va ga'ra' gu maa'nkar baasɨ'n gu maa'nkar.
Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ gu ñi'ook nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu maa'nkar jix duñia' bhaan gu maa'nkar tɨɨt gu Balaam; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n jix dhaas gu chuukug pai' cham ka't gu bhóogɨt na ba' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n tu' kɨɨ'n tu' gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ gu ñi'ook nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios mi'x juu'ñ bɨtaa'n gu Balaam; gio ba' bhaam gu Balaam naaka'n gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix kupi'ook gu chin gu ñi'ook gu Balaam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook gu jodai' dhi' vaik mui'kim.
Jano' ba' gu Balaam jix aa' gu ñi'ook; na gu' tu' jix duñia' tu'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu kuchii gu novɨ jano' tu' kooda'.
Ba' jix aa' gu ñi'ook gu Balaam; gio ba' cham jix duñia' tu' gu ñi'ook bhaan tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ dɨr tu' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm dhi' gu tanoolh; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook duñia' bɨndak jix aa'; jano' ba' cham.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix kupi'ook gu vupui gu Balaam jix ñi' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu bhóogɨt ga'ra' gu kuchii cham kutun gu novɨ; gio ba' gu Balaam jix duu tu jiim jix duñia' bhaan gu vupui.
Ba' jix aa' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' gu ux gu ñi'ook gu jodai' gu ñi'ook dhi' vaik mui'kim gu suudai' tu' gu ñi'ook na ba' gu suudai' na gu' gu bhóogɨt jix bhai'x vupui bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu' buupui gu oi'ñga'n gu vaak vupui bhaan tu' dhi' vaik mui'kim; gio ba' tu' cham gu ñi'ook gu vaak tu' gio jano' tu' kooda' tu' mi'x dhaas gu tai.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Balaam nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' uañi'ñ cham bhai'x tu' gu takarui' vupui bhaan tu' gu bhóogɨt; gu' jano' tu' gu ñi'ook cham bhai' tu' gu jodai'.
Ba' jix aa' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Balaam; gio ba' tu' bɨɨx jix duñia' gu chichio'ñ; gu' cham gu ñi'ook tu' gu takarui' gu i'ii'ñ tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' gu Balaam ka't bɨɨx chiñia' gu Balak.
Jano' ba' tɨiñ gu Balak gu Balaam gu jodai' jix buus tu jiim kiicham gu Moab ju'ñdharan gu ñi'ook gu Arnoon gu maa'nkar gu takarui'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Balak gu Balaam; gio ba' cham jix duñia' tu' mɨmɨim gu ux gu ñi'ook cham tɨbiap tu' cham gu takarui' tu' nɨidhat.
Jano' ba' gu Balaam jix aa' gu Balak; gio ba' gu suudai' tu' tɨbiap tu'; gu' gu oi'ñga'n jano' ñiokda' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu chin gu oi'ñga'n tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ka't gu Balaam bɨɨx gu Balak tɨɨtɨs kiicham gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Balak kooda' gu vaakax kakneer bhañ gu Balaam chiñia' mi'p bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tanoolh buimgidhak gu Balak jix bhɨɨ gu Balaam jix tɨ'ɨ gu oi'ñga'n gu Baal dɨr jix ñi' gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam.
Ba' jix aa' gu Balaam gu Balak; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ kɨɨv jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu ñi'ook kɨɨv ali' vaakax kɨɨv gu chuukug.
Ba' jix aa' gu Balak jix duu na ja'p gu Balaam; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Balak gu Balaam tuur gu ñi'ook jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.

Ba' jix aa' gu Balaam gu Balak; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ju'ñdharan maa'nkar tai bhaan tu' tu jiim; mi' dhɨr gu kutun gu Jawatan Dios ɨlhdham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ no'x gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu takarui' tu' gu takarui'; jano' ba' ka't gu duukam.
Ba' jix aa' suudai' u'va gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Balaam gu ux; gio ba' kɨɨv jodai maa'nkar Jawatan jix duñia' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu suudai' tuur gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios jix dhaas gu ñi'ook gu chin gu Balaam; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt gu Balak ñiokda'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu suudai' ka't ju'ñdharan maa'nkar tai bhaan bɨx chiñia' gu Moab.
Ba' jix aa' jix bhɨɨ ua'rgidhak; gio ba' gu Aram jix bhɨɨ gu Balak gu gɨ'kora' gu Moab gu kakkavɨk tas buusñi; mi' dhɨr gu kutun gu ñi'ook gu Jakob; jano' ba' gu kutun gu ñi'ook gu Israeel.
Ba' jix aa' gu ux gu ñi'ook gu takarui' tu' gu Jawatan Dios cham gu ñi'ook gu ux gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios cham tu' gu suudai'.
Na gu' na gu' gu ux gu oi'ñga'n dɨr gu ja'tkam gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' gu suudai' gu ja'tkam jix duñia' gu suudai' cham ka't jix duñia' tɨjɨɨ'ñ chɨbɨɨp.
Jano' ba' chɨkka gu ñi'ook oo' gu Jakob jɨɨ'ñdhidha' gu ñi'ook baasɨ'n gu Israeel gu jodai' gu ñi'ook koi'm gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ka't na ja'p gu jodai'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Balak gu Balaam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix bhɨɨ na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ obhɨɨ'ñ gu suudai' gu jodai' jix bhai' aa'.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' cham gu ñi'ook tu' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu chin na ba' a'ga.
Ba' jix aa' gu Balak; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu chuukug pai' dɨr jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu oi'ñga'n cham gu oi'ñga'n bɨx; jano' ba' dɨr gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' jix duu jix duñia' yooxi' gu Sopim gu ux gu Pisga kɨɨv jodai maa'nkar Jawatan makgɨrxi tuur gu ñi'ook jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Balak; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ju'ñdharan maa'nkar tai bhaan tu' tu jiim gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios jix buus gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Balaam jix dhaas gu ñi'ook gu chin; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt gu Balak a'ga.
Jano' ba' suudai' u'va gu suudai' ka't ju'ñdharan maa'nkar tai bhaan bɨɨx chiñia' gu Moab; gio ba' jix aa' gu Balak; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ ua'rgidhak; gio ba' gu Balak bamii' gu takarui'; mi' dhɨr jix kai gu ñi'ook gu mar gu Sippor.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios cham gu chio'ñ na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' tu' gu mar gu chio'ñ na ba' gu suudai'; mi' dhɨr jix aa' cham jix duñia'; jano' ba' tu ñi'ook cham jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' tu' jix bhɨɨ jix bhai' aa'; gio ba' jix bhai' aa' cham gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' cham tu' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu Jakob tu' buupui gu ñi'ook gu Israeel; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu jodai' gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' tu' jix buusñi gu Ejipto; gio ba' juraa'n tu' na jix kavɨk na ja'p maa'n.
Na gu' na gu' gu Jakob cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu takarui' tu' gu suudai' gu Israeel; gio ba' na ja'p jano' ka't tu ñi'ook gu Jakob gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu ja'tkam na ja'p maavɨt jix búup na ja'p maavɨt gu suudai'; gio ba' cham mi'x juu'ñ bɨɨx ka'm jugi gu ja'tkam gu jodai' gu ɨ'ɨr koko'kam.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Balak gu Balaam; na gu' tu' cham gu jodai' tu' gu suudai' gu oi'ñga'n.
Ba' jix aa' gu Balaam gu Balak; gio ba' cham tu' tu ñi'ook bɨx gu Jawatan Dios gu takarui' mii' dhɨr no'ñ bhaan.
Ba' jix aa' gu Balak gu Balaam; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook tu' gu jodai' pai'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' xoi'kam gu Jawatan Dios dɨr gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu Balak jix duñia' gu Balaam gu ux gu Peor tu jiim bhaan gu chuukug.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Balaam gu Balak; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ kɨɨv jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu ñi'ook kɨɨv ali' vaakax kɨɨv gu chuukug.
Ba' jix aa' gu Balak jix duu na ja'p gu Balaam; gio ba' makgɨrxi tuur gu ñi'ook jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.

Jano' ba' na ja'p jix ñi' gu Balaam gu chuukug xoi'kam gu Jawatan Dios gu oi'ñga'n gu Israeel cham ka't na ja'p gu ñi'ook gookim jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook jix dhaas gu vupui bhaan oidha' jix gaki.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu vupui jix ñi' gu Israeel gu jodai' gu ux bopxi'ñ; gio ba' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios suudai' u'va bhaan.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ ua'rgidhak; gio ba' jix aa' gu Balaam gu mar gu Beor gu chio'ñ gu vupui gu bhóogɨt.
Ba' jix aa' jix kai tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix ñi' gu ñi'ook gu jodai'; gio ba' gu vaak gu' gu bhóogɨt gu vupui.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ vaak zel gu ñi'ook gu Jakob gu ñi'ook gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu jodai' gu takarui' na ja'p gu oi'ñga'n ju'ñdharan gɨ' suudai' jiim na ja'p gu jodai' gu ux na tu ibai' gu ux gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p gɨ' u'u kavɨk ju'ñdharan gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu noobh jix duñia' gu suudai' gu kai' ka't mumua'da' gu suudai'; gio ba' jix duñia' gu gɨ'kora' gu oi'ñga'n gu Agag oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' ka't gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' jix buusñi gu Ejipto; gio ba' juraa'n tu' na jix kavɨk na ja'p maa'n; mi' dhɨr jugi chɨbɨɨp gu ñi'ook jix duñia' o'oo jix duñia' bɨɨx gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' na ba' mi'x juu'ñ na ja'p maavɨt na ja'p gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' chɨkka jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' tu' gu takarui'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu tai daak gu Balak bhaan gu Balaam gu novɨ gu ñi'ook; na ba' tu jiim obhɨɨ'ñ tu' tɨɨgim gu suudai' gu tasi' gu takarui' tu' vaik mui'kim.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu ux gu jodai' jano' pai'; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook tu' nɨidhat gu' gu suudai' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu takarui' nɨidhat.
Jano' ba' gu Balaam jix aa'; gio ba' cham gu bhóogɨt tu' gio gu takarui' gu bhóogɨt bham.

Jano' ba' tu' gu Balak koi gu vaak gu ñi'ook jix toja jodai jix uam jodai tu' cham gu oi'ñga'n bhaan tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios na ba' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix bhai' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug; gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook gu suudai' tu'.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jano' gu ja'tkam; na ba' gu ux gu jodai' gu kutun tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ dhi' gu ja'tkam tu' duñia' gu ja'tkam gu takarui' gu tanoolh.
Ba' jix aa' jix bhɨɨ ua'rgidhak; gio ba' jix aa' gu Balaam gu mar gu Beor gu chio'ñ gu vupui gu bhóogɨt.
Ba' jix aa' jix kai tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu maa'nkar gu duukam gu ñi'ook jix ñi' gu ñi'ook gu jodai'; gio ba' gu vaak gu' gu bhóogɨt gu vupui.

Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu' cham jano'; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt gu' cham mia'n; mi' dhɨr gu jodai' chi'ɨɨ' gu Jakob jix búup gu i'ii'ñ gu Israeel gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' gu Moab gu bhóogɨt bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Set.
Jano' ba' ka't jix bhɨɨ gu Edom ka't gio jix bhɨɨ gu Seir gu ux obhɨɨ'ñ gu Israeel jix duñia' gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' gu Jakob jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt kiicham jix duñia'.
Ba' jix aa' ñɨi'ñ gu Amalek jix bhɨɨ ua'rgidhak; gio ba' gu Amalek mo'o chɨbɨɨp; gu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Ba' jix aa' ñɨi'ñ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix bhɨɨ ua'rgidhak; gio ba' jix kavɨk ba'bhak jix dhaas gu jodai' na jix uam gu ñi'ook.
Na pai' dhuuk gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ka't baas na pai' dhuuk gu Assur tu' gu ñi'ook gu suudai'.
Ba' jix aa' gu bhóogɨt jix bhɨɨ ua'rgidhak; na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook chɨkka ii'mdagaram na pai' dhuuk gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan Dios dhi' tu'x.
Jano' ba' aajim gu takarui' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu Kittim gu suudai' gu Assur gu suudai' gio gu Eber; gu' gio gu ñi'ook na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix búup gu Balaam ka't jix duñia' pai'; gio ba' gio gu Balak ka't gu ux gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' jix utu'ñ gu Israeel gu Sittim gu ja'tkam jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n bɨɨx ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu Moab.
Jano' ba' tɨɨt gu ja'tkam makgɨrxi'ñdha' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu ja'tkam jix jugi jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ja'tkam gu Baal-peor; gio ba' i'iich gu Jawatan Dios gu tai bhaan gu Israeel.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ bɨx chiñia' gu ja'tkam gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios vupui bhaan gu tas; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook i'iich gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu Israeel.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Moisees gu bhóogɨt gu Israeel; gio ba' gu takarui' maa'n mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n gu Baal-peor.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu chio'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel suudai' u'va jix bhɨɨ gu jodai' gu ja'tkam gu vupui gu Moisees bɨx gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel joi'ndam ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.
Jano' ba' jix ñi' gu Pinees gu mar gu Eleasar gu mar gu Aaroon jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix búup tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook jix bhɨɨ gu suudai' gu novɨ.
Jano' ba' ka't bhaan gu chio'ñ gu Israeel vaak zel jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ gu Israeel gu u'vɨ gu ux vook; gio ba' jix utu'ñ jix koi gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix koko' mii' dhɨr jix koi gu ñi'ook maakobh jix bhai'x.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.

Jano' ba' gu Pinees gu mar gu Eleasar gu mar gu Aaroon jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan tu' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' i'iich gu ma'nkam gu Israeel baabuk gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' gu ux tu' cham gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Na ba' gu ux gu jodai' tu'; gio ba' gu Miren tu' dhi' ñi'ook na jix bhaan bhai'x i'ii'ñ bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu kai' mi' dhɨr ñi'ook na jix bhaan jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu chuukug; na gu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu ux gu Jawatan Dios jix duu gu ñi'ook gu ux gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu chio'ñ jix koi ka't jix koi bɨɨx gu jodai' ka't gu Simri gu mar gu Salu gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' ja'tkam vaak bopxi'ñ gu Simeoon.
Jano' ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu u'vɨ gu jodai' muukix ka't gu Kosbi mar u'vɨ gu Sur gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu ja'tkam gu taat ja'tkam vaak gu Madiaan.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu jodai' gu ñi'ook.

Na gu' na gu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx jix duñia' gu suudai' gu chuukug gu Peor gu chuukug gu Kosbi mar u'vɨ gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu Madiaan gu ja'tkam ka't muukix gu tanoolh jix koi gu ux kuiñcha gu Peor.
Ba' jix aa' ka't mi' dhɨr jix koi gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees gu Eleasar gu mar jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Aaroon bham.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu suudai' bɨx gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu ñi'ook gu takarui' jiix gu ux gu vaak tattat bɨx gu takarui' jix buus bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu Moisees gu Eleasar jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan tu ñi'ook bɨɨx vaak ja'tkam gu Moab ju'ñdharan gu Jordaan gu Jerikoo bham.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu takarui' jiix na ja'p jix aa'ñdhix gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' gu Rubeen maa'nkam mar gu Israeel; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Rubeen; mi' dhɨr gu anok ka't ja'tkam vaak gu anokîtas; jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ja'tkam vaak gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu esroon ja'tkam vaak gu esronitas; gio ba' gu Karmi ja'tkam vaak gu Karmitas.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam vaak gu jodai'; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n jix bɨɨx duu oo'm vaik ja'tkam vaak gu chuukug gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' gu Eliab.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Eliab; gio ba' gu Nemuel gu Dataan gu Abiram; na pai' dhuuk dhi' ja'tkam gu Dataan gu Abiram jix bɨɨx duu gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook jix duu gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan gu Moisees gu Aaroon bɨɨx chu'p gu Koree na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.

Na pai' dhuuk gu oidha' jix kupi'ook gu chin jix duñia' gu Koree na pai' dhuuk mii' dhɨr chu'p jix koi na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' gu tai gu oi'ñga'n mambhɨɨx gu chichio'ñ jix bɨɨx duu gu ux nɨi'ñchudat.
Gu' gu' gu ma'nkam gu Koree cham jix koko'.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Simeoon gu ux ja'tkam vaak; gio ba' gu Nemuel ja'tkam vaak gu Nemuelitas; mi' dhɨr gu Jamiin ja'tkam vaak gu Jaminitas; jano' ba' gu Jakîn ja'tkam vaak gu Jakînitas.
Jano' ba' gu Sera ja'tkam vaak gu Seraitas; gio ba' gu Sauul ja'tkam vaak gu Saulitas.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam vaak gu Simeonitas gu ñi'ook gook ja'tkam vaak gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Gad gu ux ja'tkam vaak; gio ba' gu Sepoon ja'tkam vaak gu Seponitas; mi' dhɨr gu Aggi ja'tkam vaak gu Aggitas; jano' ba' gu Suni ja'tkam vaak gu Sunitas.
Jano' ba' gu Osni ja'tkam vaak gu Osnitas; gio ba' gu Eri ja'tkam vaak gu Eritas.
Jano' ba' gu Aros ja'tkam vaak gu Aroditas; gio ba' gu Areli ja'tkam vaak gu Arelitas.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam vaak gu Gad gu ux gu oi'ñga'n oo'm ja'tkam vaak gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Judaa; gio ba' gu Er gu Onaan; mi' dhɨr gu Er gu Onaan jix koko' gu oidha' gu Kanaan.
Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu Judaa gu ux ja'tkam vaak; gio ba' gu Sela ja'tkam vaak gu Selaitas; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' ja'tkam vaak gu ñi'ook; jano' ba' gu Sera ja'tkam vaak gu Seraitas.
Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu suudai'; gio ba' gu esroon ja'tkam vaak gu esronitas; mi' dhɨr gu amul ja'tkam vaak gu amulitas.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam vaak gu Judaa gu ux gu oi'ñga'n gu vaak gu ux ja'tkam vaak gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Issakâr gu ux ja'tkam vaak; gio ba' gu Tola ja'tkam vaak gu Tolaitas; mi' dhɨr gu Puaa ja'tkam vaak gu Puanitas.
Jano' ba' gu Jasub ja'tkam vaak gu Jasubitas; gio ba' gu Simron ja'tkam vaak gu Simronitas.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam vaak gu Issakâr gu ux gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook maakobh ja'tkam vaak vaik.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu ñi'ook gu ux ja'tkam vaak; gio ba' gu Sered ja'tkam vaak gu Sereditas; mi' dhɨr gu Eloon ja'tkam vaak gu Elonitas; jano' ba' gu Jalel ja'tkam vaak gu Jalelitas.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam vaak gu ñi'ook gu ux gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook ja'tkam vaak gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Josee gu ux ja'tkam vaak; gio ba' gu Manasees gu Epraim.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Manasees; gio ba' gu Makîr ja'tkam vaak gu Makîritas; mi' dhɨr gu Makîr jix mar gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ja'tkam vaak gu duukam.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu ma'nkam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' gu ñi'ook ja'tkam vaak gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu elek ja'tkam vaak gu elekitas.
Jano' ba' gu Asriel ja'tkam vaak gu Asrielitas; gio ba' gu Sekêm ja'tkam vaak gu Sekêmitas.
Jano' ba' gu Semida ja'tkam vaak gu Semidaitas; gio ba' gu eper ja'tkam vaak gu eperitas.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu mar gu eper cham jix duñia' gu ma'nkam gu ñi'ook ma'nkam u'uuvɨ; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' ma'nkam u'uuvɨ jix duñia' jix bɨɨx duu gu Maala gu Noa gu ogla gu Milka gu Tirsa.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam vaak gu Manasees; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n mambhɨɨx gook ja'tkam vaak gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu ma'nkam gu Epraim gu ux ja'tkam vaak; gio ba' gu Sutala ja'tkam vaak gu Sutalaitas; mi' dhɨr gu Bekêr ja'tkam vaak gu Bekêritas; jano' ba' gu Taan ja'tkam vaak gu Taanitas.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu ma'nkam gu Sutala; gio ba' gu eraan ja'tkam vaak gu eranitas.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam vaak gu ma'nkam gu Epraim gu ux gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gook ja'tkam vaak gu takarui'; gio ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu ma'nkam gu Josee gu ux ja'tkam vaak.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin gu ux ja'tkam vaak; gio ba' gu Bela ja'tkam vaak gu Belaitas; mi' dhɨr gu Asbel ja'tkam vaak gu Asbelitas; jano' ba' gu takarui' ja'tkam vaak gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' gu Supam ja'tkam vaak gu Supamitas; gio ba' gu upam ja'tkam vaak gu upamitas.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Bela jix bɨɨx duu gu Ard gu Naamaan; gio ba' gu Ard ja'tkam vaak gu Arditas; mi' dhɨr gu Naamaan ja'tkam vaak gu Naamanitas.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin gu ux ja'tkam vaak; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n oo'm jixchamaam ja'tkam vaak gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu ma'nkam gu Dan gu ux ja'tkam vaak; gio ba' gu Suam ja'tkam vaak gu Suamitas; mi' dhɨr dhi' ja'tkam vaak gu Dan gu ux ja'tkam vaak.
Jano' ba' bɨx ja'tkam vaak gu Suamitas gu ux gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook maakobh ja'tkam vaak gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Aser gu ux ja'tkam vaak; gio ba' gu Imna ja'tkam vaak gu Imnaitas; mi' dhɨr gu Issui ja'tkam vaak gu Issuitas; jano' ba' gu Beria ja'tkam vaak gu Beriaitas.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Beria; gio ba' gu eber ja'tkam vaak gu eberitas; mi' dhɨr gu Malkîel ja'tkam vaak gu Malkîelitas.
Jano' ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' mar u'vɨ gu Aser ka't gu Sera.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam vaak gu ma'nkam gu Aser gu ux gu oi'ñga'n mambhɨɨx vaik ja'tkam vaak gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu chuukug gu ux ja'tkam vaak; gio ba' gu Jaseel ja'tkam vaak gu Jaseelitas; mi' dhɨr gu Guni ja'tkam vaak gu Gunitas.
Jano' ba' gu Jeser ja'tkam vaak gu Jeseritas; gio ba' gu Sillem ja'tkam vaak gu Sillemitas.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam vaak gu chuukug gu ux ja'tkam vaak; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n oo'm jixchamaam ja'tkam vaak gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu oi'ñga'n gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu bhóogɨt jix bhai'x gu chuukug gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oidha' gu maa'nkar gu ux jix duñia' gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n maa'n jix gɨ' gu maa'nkar gu ñi'ook jix ali'; gio ba' maa'n gu maa'nkar jurtu'nka' gu oi'ñga'n.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook gu oidha' ka't gu chuukug gu ux gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' gu ux gu tɨɨgɨ' bopxi'ñ tattat gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jurtu'nka' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ka't gu chuukug gu maa'nkar tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix gɨ' jix ali'.

Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu Lebitas gu ux ja'tkam vaak dhi' ja'tkam; gio ba' gu Gersoon ja'tkam vaak gu Gersonitas; mi' dhɨr gu Koat ja'tkam vaak gu Koatitas; jano' ba' gu Merari ja'tkam vaak gu Meraritas.

Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam vaak gu Lebitas; gio ba' ja'tkam vaak gu Libnitas ja'tkam vaak gu ebronitas ja'tkam vaak gu Maalitas ja'tkam vaak gu Musitas ja'tkam vaak gu Koritas; mi' dhɨr gu Koat jix mar gu Amram.
Jano' ba' gu u'vɨ gu Amram jup tɨɨt gu Jokâbed mar u'vɨ gu Lebii jix duñia' gu Lebii gu Ejipto; gio ba' gu chuukug jix duñia' gu Amram gu Aaroon gu Moisees gu Mariia gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu Aaroon jix duñia' gu Nadab gu Abiuu gu Eleasar gu Itamar.
Na pai' dhuuk gu' gu Nadab gu Abiuu jix koko' na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' gu tai gu tanoolh vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu Lebitas jix bɨɨx duu gu ñi'ook vaik jix bhai'x bɨx gu chichio'ñ gu takarui' jiix; na gu' cham jix bɨɨx duu gu oi'ñga'n tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel na gu' cham ka't gu suudai' gu jodai' gu maa'nkar tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu oi'ñga'n gu ux gu Moisees gu Eleasar jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix duñia' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel vaak ja'tkam gu Moab ju'ñdharan gu Jordaan gu Jerikoo.
Jano' ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ dhi' ja'tkam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ka't gu oi'ñga'n gu ux gu Moisees gu Aaroon jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix duñia' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel oidha' jix gaki gu Sinaii.
Ba' jix aa' na gu' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix duñia' koi oidha' jix gaki; mi' dhɨr cham gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Kaleb gu mar gu Jepone gu Josuee gu mar gu Nun.

Jano' ba' ma'nkam u'uuvɨ jix duñia' gu mar gu eper gu mar gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu mar gu Makîr gu mar gu Manasees ja'tkam vaak gu Manasees gu mar gu Josee gu tɨɨgɨ' jix duñia' gu Maala gu Noa gu ogla gu Milka gu Tirsa jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' vupui bhaan gu Moisees vupui bhaan jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Eleasar vupui bhaan chiñia' bɨx gu ñi'ook ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut gui'p.
Jano' ba' chulhiiñdha' gu taat jix koi oidha' jix gaki cham juruuñ gu kutun jum daa'ñ bhaan gu Jawatan Dios chu'p gu Koree; gu' gu ñi'ook uañi'ñ jix koi cham jix duñia' gu ma'nkam.

Jano' ba' gu ux gu ñi'ook ka't gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu tɨɨgɨ' chulhiiñdha' gu taat tɨjɨɨ'ñ ja'tkam vaak gu ux cham gu suudai' jix duñia' gu mar gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam chulhiiñdha' gu taat.
Jano' ba' gu Moisees jix duñia' kuiñcha vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix aa' gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' xoi'kam tu ñi'ook ma'nkam u'uuvɨ jix duñia'; gio ba' jix maa gu maa'nkar tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam gu taat; mi' dhɨr bhaan gu maa'nkar gu taat.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel tu ñi'ook bham; na pai' dhuuk oi'ñdha' gu jodai' cham gu ma'nkam bhaan gu oi'ñga'n mar u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' tu' cham jix duñia' mar u'vɨ jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' tu' cham jix duñia' gu ja'tkam jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n gu ja'tkam gu taat.

Jano' ba' tu' gu taat cham jix duñia' gu ja'tkam jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n jir bɨx bhai' gu oi'ñga'n mia'n gu ma'nkam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' ka't gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu ux ñi'ook kavɨk gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix gu Moisees.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' jix tɨ'ɨ dhi' gu kavɨk gu Abarim gu oi'ñga'n gu oidha' jix maa gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu oi'ñga'n buupui tu' gio ka' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam na ja'p ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ xibhɨk gu Aaroon.
Na gu' jix bɨɨx duu gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu ñi'ook oidha' jix gaki gu Sin gu ñi'ook na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai' gu vupui; gio ba' dhi' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu Kades oidha' jix gaki gu Sin.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix aa' gu Moisees gu Jawatan Dios bham.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ bɨx gu chuukug gu chio'ñ bhaan gu ñi'ook.
Na gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan tɨjɨɨ'ñ vupui bhaan gu bhóogɨt gu suudai'; na gu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios cham ka't na ja'p kakneer cham bipia'dam.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Josuee gu mar gu Nun gu chio'ñ cham tu'x jai'ch gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu bhóogɨt gu novɨ bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt vupui bhaan gu Eleasar jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan vupui bhaan bɨx gu ñi'ook; gio ba' maa'n gu bhóogɨt gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' bhaan na ba' bɨx gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu suudai'.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu Eleasar jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan tu ñi'ook gu ux ñi'ook na jir bhai' gu Urim vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu ux tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook gu ux jɨjɨkgɨm bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bɨɨx bɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Moisees na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix aa'ñdhix; na jix bhɨɨ gu Josuee jix dhaas vupui bhaan gu Eleasar jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan bɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas bhaan gu noobh jix maa gu bhóogɨt na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix aa'ñdhix gu ux gu novɨ gu Moisees.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu takarui'; gio ba' gu maa'nkar gu takarui' bɨɨx gu maa'nkar gu vaak na jix bhai' gu ñi'ook tu' jix bhai'x nukadham gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' daipu'; gio ba' dhi' gu maa'nkar gu vaak na jix bhai' gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gook gu ja'tkam cham gu oi'ñga'n oi'ñga' gu tanoolh ka't maa'nkar tai bhaan gu vaak na jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' mar kaneer gu jodai' gu ux gu xibh mar kaneer gu jodai' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gook xib ja'k tɨkɨr.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Epa gu chuukug gu vaak gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨ'ñdhatu' gu chuukug gu o'o.
Jano' ba' maa'nkar tai bhaan gu vaak na jix bhai' ka't gu ñi'ook gu kavɨk gu Sinaii gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu maa'nkar gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx mar kaneer; gio ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu vaak na jix bhai' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim suudai' u'va gu Jawatan Dios xidhuu.

Jano' ba' gu jodai' gook mar kaneer tɨjɨɨ'ñ gook xib ja'k tɨkɨr; gio ba' jurtu'nka' gu maa'nkar gu xibh jurtu'nka' gu vaak na jix bhai' gu jodai' gu maa'nkar gu vaak na jix bhai' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Gu' gu' gu tanoolh juanda' gook gu ja'tkam oi'ñga' cham gu jodai' gook gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu vaak gu ñi'ook bɨɨx bɨ'ñdhatu' gu ux gu o'o bɨɨx gu vaak na jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' maa'nkar tai bhaan juanda' gu suudai' maa'nkar tai bhaan gu vaak na jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam masaa'n gu bhóogɨt maa'nkar tai bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gook ali' vaakax gu ñi'ook kɨɨv gu ja'tkam oi'ñga' cham gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' vaik gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu vaak gu ñi'ook bɨɨx bɨ'ñdhatu' gu ux gu o'o bɨɨx tuur; gio ba' gook gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu vaak gu ñi'ook bɨɨx bɨ'ñdhatu' gu ux gu o'o bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu vaak gu ñi'ook bɨɨx bɨ'ñdhatu' gu maa'nkar gu ux gu o'o bɨɨx mar kaneer; gio ba' maa'nkar tai bhaan gu ñi'ook gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu maa'nkar gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' suudai' u'va tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx tuur gu chuukug gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx mar kaneer; gio ba' dhi' maa'nkar tai bhaan gu takarui' gu ux gu bhóogɨt masaa'n oi'ñga'.
Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ chiiw gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios gu suudai' maa'nkar tai bhaan gu vaak na jix bhai' bɨɨx gu vaak na jix bhai'.
Gu' gu' gu takarui' maa'n gu ñi'ook gu takarui' ka't gakdhi'ñchix gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook gu takarui' jix duñia'; gio ba' gu ux kɨɨv gu tanoolh jugi gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' maa'n gu tanoolh abhaar gu ñi'ook; gio ba' matgɨm gu ñi'ook gu takarui' jix duu.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu ux gu maa'nkar gu vaak na jix bhai' maa'nkar tai bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gook ali' vaakax gu ñi'ook kɨɨv gu ja'tkam oi'ñga'; gio ba' cham gu jodai' jix bhɨɨ.
Jano' ba' gu o'o gu vaak gu ñi'ook bɨɨx bɨ'ñdhatu'; gio ba' vaik gu ñi'ook bɨɨx tuur gook gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx maa'n kɨɨv gu ja'tkam gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ chiiw gu ux gu ñi'ook na ba' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' maa'nkar tai bhaan gu xibh maa'nkar tai bhaan gu vaak na jix bhai'.

Jano' ba' jurtu'nka' dhi' gu bhóogɨt maa'n kɨɨv gu tanoolh gu kutun gu maa'nkar gu vaak na jix bhai' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' maa'nkar tai bhaan gu vaak na jix bhai' bɨɨx gu vaak na jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' kɨɨv gu tanoolh jix duñia' abhaar gu ñi'ook; gio ba' matgɨm gu ñi'ook gu takarui' jix duu.
Na pai' dhuuk gu suudai' gu tanoolh gu ux na tu ibai' na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook gu o'o jix vɨɨk gu Jawatan Dios gu chuukug jix duñia' abhaar gu ñi'ook; gio ba' matgɨm gu ñi'ook gu takarui' jix duu.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt maa'nkar tai bhaan gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gook ali' vaakax gu ñi'ook kɨɨv gu ja'tkam oi'ñga'.
Jano' ba' gu o'o gu chuukug gu vaak gu ñi'ook bɨɨx bɨ'ñdhatu' vaik gu ñi'ook bɨɨx tuur gook gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx maa'n kɨɨv gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ chiiw na ba' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu ux gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' maa'nkar tai bhaan gu vaak na jix bhai' bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n gu vaak na jix bhai'; gio ba' cham gu jodai' jix bhɨɨ.
Jano' ba' kɨɨv gu takarui' maa'n gu takarui' jix duñia' abhaar gu ñi'ook; gio ba' matgɨm gu ñi'ook gu takarui' jix duu; mi' dhɨr ka't gu tanoolh gu mar kuu'ñdham na jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt maa'nkar tai bhaan gu ux gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios tuur gu ñi'ook kɨɨv gu ja'tkam oi'ñga' cham gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' gu o'o gu chuukug gu vaak gu ñi'ook bɨɨx bɨ'ñdhatu' vaik gu ñi'ook bɨɨx tuur gook gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx maa'n kɨɨv gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ chiiw gu ux gu ñi'ook na ba' jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' gu suudai' maa'nkar tai bhaan gu takarui' gu o'o maa'nkar tai bhaan gu vaak na jix bhai' gu o'o gu vaak na jix bhai' jurtu'nka' ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu ux gu maa'nkar gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' mambhɨɨx dhi' gu takarui' kɨɨv jix duñia' abhaar gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' matgɨm gu ñi'ook jix duu.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt maa'nkar tai bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu ux gu ñi'ook jix duñia' tuur gu ñi'ook kɨɨv gu ja'tkam oi'ñga'; gio ba' cham gu jodai' jix bhɨɨ.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu chuukug gu vaak gu ñi'ook bɨɨx bɨ'ñdhatu' vaik gu ñi'ook bɨɨx tuur gook gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx maa'n kɨɨv gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ chiiw gu ux gu maa'nkar; gio ba' gu suudai' gu maa'nkar gu ux uañi'ñ maa'nkar tai bhaan gu vaak na jix bhai' gu oi'ñga'n gu vaak na jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' gio gu bhóogɨt gu tanoolh gu takarui' kɨɨv jix duñia' abhaar gu ñi'ook; gio ba' matgɨm gu ñi'ook gu takarui' jix duu gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu ux kɨɨv gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt maa'nkar tai bhaan gu maa'nkar gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu suudai' ali' vaakax gu ñi'ook gook gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam oi'ñga'; gio ba' jix duñia' gu suudai' cham gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu chuukug gu vaak gu ñi'ook bɨɨx bɨ'ñdhatu' vaik gu ñi'ook bɨɨx maa'n gu suudai' ali' vaakax gook gu ñi'ook bɨɨx maa'n gook gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx maa'n gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ chiiw gu ux gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' gu suudai' maa'nkar tai bhaan gu vaak na jix bhai' gu o'o gu vaak na jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' gook gu tanoolh gu kutun ali' vaakax gu ñi'ook gook gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam oi'ñga' cham gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu vaak na jix bhai' bɨɨx ali' vaakax bɨɨx gu chuukug bɨɨx gu ja'tkam bhaan jɨɨ'ñdhidha' jurtu'nka' ñi'ook na tu a'ga.
Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ chiiw gu ux gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' gu suudai' maa'nkar tai bhaan gu vaak na jix bhai' gu o'o gu vaak na jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu tanoolh vaik gu kutun ali' vaakax gook gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam oi'ñga' cham gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu vaak na jix bhai' bɨɨx ali' vaakax bɨɨx gu chuukug bɨɨx gu ja'tkam bhaan jɨɨ'ñdhidha' jurtu'nka' ñi'ook na tu a'ga.
Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ chiiw gu ux gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' gu suudai' maa'nkar tai bhaan gu vaak na jix bhai' gu o'o gu vaak na jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' maakobh gu tanoolh mambhɨɨx ali' vaakax gook gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam oi'ñga' cham gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu vaak na jix bhai' bɨɨx ali' vaakax bɨɨx gu chuukug bɨɨx gu ja'tkam bhaan jɨɨ'ñdhidha' jurtu'nka' ñi'ook na tu a'ga.
Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ chiiw gu ux gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' gu suudai' maa'nkar tai bhaan gu vaak na jix bhai' gu o'o gu vaak na jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' jixchamaam gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook ali' vaakax gook gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam oi'ñga' cham gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu vaak na jix bhai' bɨɨx ali' vaakax bɨɨx gu chuukug bɨɨx gu ja'tkam bhaan jɨɨ'ñdhidha' jurtu'nka' ñi'ook na tu a'ga.
Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ chiiw gu ux gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' gu suudai' maa'nkar tai bhaan gu vaak na jix bhai' gu o'o gu vaak na jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' xijumai gu tanoolh gu tasi' ali' vaakax gook gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam oi'ñga' cham gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu vaak na jix bhai' bɨɨx ali' vaakax bɨɨx gu chuukug bɨɨx gu ja'tkam bhaan jɨɨ'ñdhidha' jurtu'nka' ñi'ook na tu a'ga.
Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ chiiw gu ux gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' gu suudai' maa'nkar tai bhaan gu vaak na jix bhai' gu o'o gu vaak na jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' kɨɨv gu tanoolh kɨɨv ali' vaakax gook gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam oi'ñga' cham gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu vaak na jix bhai' bɨɨx ali' vaakax bɨɨx gu chuukug bɨɨx gu ja'tkam bhaan jɨɨ'ñdhidha' jurtu'nka' ñi'ook na tu a'ga.
Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ chiiw gu ux gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' gu suudai' maa'nkar tai bhaan gu vaak na jix bhai' bɨɨx gu o'o gu vaak na jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' jix bhai'x gu tanoolh jix duñia'; gio ba' matgɨm gu ñi'ook gu takarui' jix duu.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt maa'nkar tai bhaan gu maa'nkar gu vaak na jix bhai' gu ñi'ook gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak gu ñi'ook kɨɨv gu ja'tkam oi'ñga' cham gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu vaak na jix bhai' bɨɨx gu vaak bɨɨx gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu ja'tkam bhaan jɨɨ'ñdhidha' jurtu'nka' ñi'ook na tu a'ga.
Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ chiiw gu ux gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' gu suudai' maa'nkar tai bhaan gu vaak na jix bhai' bɨɨx gu o'o gu vaak na jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' dhi' tu'x gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n na ba' maa'nkar tai bhaan na ba' gu oi'ñga'n na ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' na ba' gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' dhi' tu'x gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n na ba' maa'nkar tai bhaan na ba' gu oi'ñga'n na ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' na ba' gu chuukug.
Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jurtu'nka' bɨx gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix aa'ñdhix.
Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees chiñia' bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bham; gio ba' dhi' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix aa'ñdhix.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk oi'ñdha' gu oi'ñga'n gu tasi' gu Jawatan Dios gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu i'ii'ñ bɨɨx gu takarui' cham jix duñia' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix duñia' jurtu'nka' bɨx jix buus gu chin.
Na pai' dhuuk gu' gu u'vɨ na pai' dhuuk gu oi'ñga'n gu tasi' gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx gu takarui' gu vaak gu taat jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu taat gu ñi'ook gu tasi' gu takarui' bɨɨx jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ gu taat gu chuukug gu i'ii'ñ bɨx gu oi'ñga'n ka't jiimda' bɨx gu takarui' bɨɨx ka't gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook ka't.
Gu' gu' tu' gu taat gu chuukug gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook bɨx gu oi'ñga'n gu takarui' bɨɨx ka't gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ cham ka't jiimda'; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios uañi'ñka' na gu' gu taat jix duñia'.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook tu' ka't gu takarui' gu oi'ñga'n gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx gu bhóogɨt gu i'ii'ñ.
Na pai' dhuuk tu' gu chio'ñ gu ñi'ook na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu i'ii'ñ gu oi'ñga'n ka't jiimda' gu takarui' bɨɨx jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook ka't.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu' tu' na pai' dhuuk gu chio'ñ jix kai jix duñia' jano' ba' gu tasi' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ ka't gu suudai'; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios uañi'ñka'.
Gu' gu' bɨx gu tasi' ja'tkam na jix xoi'kam gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu i'ii'ñ ka't gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' ka't gu ñi'ook gu tasi' gu vaak gu chio'ñ ka't gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ bɨɨx gu takarui' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' gu chio'ñ jix kai gu chuukug gu i'ii'ñ cham jix duñia'; gio ba' jano' ba' bɨx gu oi'ñga'n ka't jiimda' bɨx gu takarui' bɨɨx ka't gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook ka't.

Gu' gu' tu' gu chio'ñ jix duñia' gu tanoolh jix kai; gio ba' bɨx jix buus gu ñi'ook gu jodai' gu oi'ñga'n gu jodai' gu takarui' gu i'ii'ñ ka't gu suudai'; mi' dhɨr gu chio'ñ jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios uañi'ñka'.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu tasi' bɨx gu ñi'ook gu jodai' gu suudai' gu i'ii'ñ gu chio'ñ jix duñia' gu chio'ñ jix duñia'.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook tu' gu chio'ñ gu chuukug gu i'ii'ñ gu tanoolh jano' ba' jix duñia' bɨx gu oi'ñga'n bɨx gu takarui' bhaan; na gu' jix duñia' na gu' gu chuukug gu i'ii'ñ gu tanoolh jix kai.

Gu' gu' tu' gu chuukug mi' dhɨr jix duñia' naak jano' ba' jix duñia' uañi'ñ; gio ba' dhi' gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix gu Moisees tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chio'ñ gu u'vɨ tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu taat mar u'vɨ gu suudai' jix duñia' gu vaak gu taat.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' gu vupui gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bhaan gu jodai'; gio ba' mi' dhɨr ka' gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Moisees gu ja'tkam bham; gio ba' gu Armaos dhɨt gu ñi'ook na ba' bhɨɨ'ñdham gu ñi'ook bhaan gu Madiaan jix duu gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Madiaan.
Jano' ba' jix bhai'x bopxi'ñ bɨx bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu ñi'ook bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu oi'ñga'n gu Israeel jix bhai'x gu ux bopxi'ñ gu kutun jix bhai'x gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham.

Jano' ba' gu Moisees bhañ bhɨɨ'ñdham; gio ba' jix bhai'x bopxi'ñ bhañ; mi' dhɨr gu Pinees gu mar gu Eleasar jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan ka't bhɨɨ'ñdham bɨɨx jɨɨgi'ñdham gu oi'ñga'n bɨɨx gu bhóogɨt gu novɨ na ba' kuichdha'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' bhaan gu Madiaan na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix gu Moisees mu'aa bɨx gu chio'ñ.
Jano' ba' mu'aa gio tɨjɨɨ'ñ koko'kam gu gɨ'kora' gu Madiaan; gio ba' gu Ebi gu Rekem gu Sur gu ur gu Reba jixchamaam gu gɨ'kora' gu Madiaan; mi' dhɨr gu Balaam gio gu mar gu Beor mu'aa gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' bhɨɨk gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu u'vɨ gu bhóogɨt bɨx gu vaakax bɨx gu suudai'; gio ba' jix duñia' bɨx gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' bɨɨx gu tai bɨx jɨ'dɨlh taañpu' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ bɨx gu takarui' bɨx gu ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ na ja'p gu vaakax.
Jano' ba' aichdhak gu Moisees gu Eleasar jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu chuukug gu ja'tkam gu takarui' yooxi' gu bhóogɨt gu Moab ju'ñdharan gu Jordaan gu Jerikoo.
Jano' ba' moor gu Moisees gu Eleasar jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan bɨx chiñia' gu ñi'ook tu jiim mai' yooxi'.
Jano' ba' bhaam gu Moisees bhaan gu ñi'ook ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham bhaan bopxi'ñ gu bhóogɨt bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees; gio ba' bɨx gu u'vɨ jix duñia' gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu ux gu bhóogɨt gu Balaam na ba' gu chuukug bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu chuukug gu Peor; gio ba' gu ux ka't jix koi gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' jano' bɨx gu chichio'ñ tɨjɨɨ'ñ a'aalh; gio ba' gu takarui' gio bɨx gu u'vɨ ka't gu tasi' gu chio'ñ gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu u'vɨ cham gu oi'ñga'n gu tasi' gu oi'ñga'n gu chio'ñ jix duñia' na jix do'ig.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' gu jodai' mai' yooxi' kɨɨv gu tanoolh; gio ba' bɨx gu oi'ñga'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook no'x ka't dhaa jix koi jix duñia' vaik kɨɨv gu tanoolh gu takarui' gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' jix duñia' bɨx tɨi'chu' bɨx gu jodai' tɨɨt bɨx gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu ñi'ook bɨx gu ux gu u'u.
Ba' jix aa' gu Eleasar jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu chichio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham aajidha' bhɨɨ'ñdham; gio ba' dhi' jir bɨx bhai' ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix aa'ñdhix gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix uam jodai jix toja jodai gu jodai' na jix uam jix kavɨk jodai dhi' gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' bɨx jix duñia' gu tai gu ux gu tai jix duu gu ñi'ook ka't na jix bhai' xoi'kam gu suudai' gu jodai' gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia'; gu' jix duu gu ñi'ook gu ux gu suudai' bɨx cham gu oi'ñga'n gu tai.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' jix duñia' jajannulhi'ñ kɨɨv gu tanoolh ka't gu suudai'; gio ba' mi' dhɨr jɨjɨkgɨm yooxi'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ jix duñia' gu ja'tkam tu' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt na ja'p gu vaakax tu' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Eleasar ɨɨbhidham tattat gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' moor bhɨɨ'ñdham bɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt na ba' gu Jawatan Dios namki'ñdha' gu chichio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham moor bhɨɨ'ñdham; gio ba' gu takarui' maa'n gu bhóogɨt na ja'p gu vaakax gu ñi'ook kakneer.
Jano' ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu takarui' jix bhɨɨ; gio ba' maa'n gu Eleasar jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu maa'nkar gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix bhɨɨ maa'n mambhɨɨx gu bhóogɨt gu vaakax gu ñi'ook kakneer bɨx gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n; gio ba' maa'n gu Lebitas namki' jix nukadham vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Moisees gu Eleasar jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' ka't gu ja'tkam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam jix bhɨɨ gu chichio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham gu bhóogɨt gu vaak jixchamaam jix bhai'x kakneer.
Jano' ba' gu vaak gook jix bhai'x gu vaakax.
Jano' ba' gu vaak jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' gu bhóogɨt gu u'vɨ cham gu suudai' gu tasi' gu oi'ñga'n gu chio'ñ bɨx gu ñi'ook gook jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ baasɨ'n gu suudai' gu ñi'ook bhɨɨ'ñdham ka't jɨɨ'ñdhidha' vaik gu ñi'ook kɨɨv jix bhai'x gu takarui' kakneer.
Jano' ba' namki'ñdha' na ba' gu Jawatan Dios kakneer ka't gu bhóogɨt gu vaak jixchamaam.
Jano' ba' gu vaakax gu ñi'ook gu ux jix bhai'x; gio ba' namki'ñdha' na ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak gook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x gu takarui'; gio ba' namki'ñdha' na ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak maa'n.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt mambhɨɨx gu ux jix bhai'x; gio ba' namki'ñdha' na ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gook gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' jix maa gu Moisees namki'ñdha' gu ux gu jodai' gu maa'nkar gu Jawatan Dios gu Eleasar jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix ai'chdhix gu Moisees gu chichio'ñ gu suudai' gu ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ba' gu ñi'ook ka't; gio ba' kakneer vaik gu ñi'ook kɨɨv jix bhai'x gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' gu vaakax gu ñi'ook gu ux jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt mambhɨɨx gu ux jix bhai'x; gio ba'.

Jano' ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix bhɨɨ gu Moisees maa'n mambhɨɨx gu bhóogɨt na ja'p gu vaakax jix maa gu Lebitas ko'kmarak jix nukadham vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix aa'ñdhix gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Moisees gu takarui' gu oi'ñga'n mii' dhɨr ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham bopxi'ñ gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gui'p gu Moisees; gio ba' tu duukam jix duñia' jix bhɨɨ gu oi'ñga'n gu chichio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham chulhiiñdha' gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu suudai' no'ch.

Jano' ba' gu ux gu jodai' gu suudai' gu Jawatan Dios gu maa'nkar maa'n tu' gaagam gu ux jix uam jodai gu ux gu oi'ñga'n gu ja'tkam gu takarui' gu jodai' na ba' gu vupui gu ñi'ook gu ux gu i'ii'ñ vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu Moisees jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Eleasar jix duñia' jix uam jodai gu ñi'ook bɨx gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' bɨx jix uam jodai gu maa'nkar jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios bopxi'ñ gu bhóogɨt ka't mambhɨɨx gu ux jix bhai'x gu chuukug mambhɨɨx gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gu chichio'ñ ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu suudai' gu takarui' maa'n na ba'.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Moisees jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Eleasar jix uam jodai bopxi'ñ gu bhóogɨt aichdhak vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut gu ux chɨ'ñchoka' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Rubeen gu ma'nkam gu Gad ko'kmarak gu bhóogɨt jix gɨ' gu oi'ñga'n gu vaakax; gio ba' ñɨi'ñ gu oidha' gu Jaser gu Galaad jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n pai' gu vaakax.
Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs gu ma'nkam gu Gad gu ma'nkam gu Rubeen tu ñi'ook gu Moisees gu Eleasar jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan chiñia' gu ñi'ook bham.
Jano' ba' gu Atarot gu Diboon gu Jaser gu Nimra gu esboon gu Eleale gu ñi'ook gu Nebo gu Beoon.
Jano' ba' gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios naaka'n vupui bhaan gu ñi'ook gu Israeel gu oidha' gu vaakax tu duukam namki' gu vaakax.
Na ba' gu ux gu jodai' gui'p tu' bakia' nɨidhidha' gu vupui jix duñia' dhi' gu oidha' tu duukam gu maa'nkar cham gu ñi'ook gu Jordaan.
Jano' ba' jix aa' gu Moisees gu ma'nkam gu Gad gu ma'nkam gu Rubeen; gio ba' aajim gu ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu ñi'ook jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu ux gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel na ba' cham gu bhóogɨt gu oidha' tu' jix maa gu Jawatan Dios.
Na pai' dhuuk jix duu tattat na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' dɨr gu Kades-barnea na ba' gu jodai' gu oidha'.
Na jix tɨ'ɨ bɨɨx ka'm gu suudai' gu Eskol mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu oidha' jix duñia' gu takarui' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel na ba' cham gu oi'ñga'n gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix maa.
Jano' ba' i'iich gu Jawatan Dios gu tai jano' ba' gu ñi'ook bham.
Na gu' cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chichio'ñ jix tɨ'ɨ gu Ejipto gu ñi'ook gu takarui' jiix gu oidha' gu ux gu takarui' gu Abraam gu Isaak gu Jakob na gu' cham jix bɨɨx duu gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook tu'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Kaleb gu mar gu Jepone gu Keneseo gu Josuee gu mar gu Nun jix bɨɨx duu gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' jix duu i'iich gu Jawatan Dios gu tai gu Israeel gu ja'tkam gu chuukug oo'm gu takarui' gu ux oidha' jix gaki bɨɨx ka'm ka't gu ñi'ook bɨx mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook ka't gu ñi'ook cham bhai' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu takarui' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook pai' tattat gu oi'ñga'n gu chichio'ñ u'ua'tulhdhix na ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' tu' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook jix duñia' mi'x dhaas oidha' jix gaki gu ñi'ook bɨx dhi' gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix duñia' gui'p; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu takarui' na ba' chulhiiñdha' gu vaakax jɨ'dɨlh na ba' gu ñi'ook a'aalh.
Jano' ba' no'ch gu ñi'ook gu takarui' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bɨɨx ka'm gu chuukug pai'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook a'aalh jix duñia' jɨ'dɨlh jix kavɨk kuiñcha jix koi gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' cham gu ñi'ook baak gu vaak bɨɨx ka'm gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim maa'n gu maa'nkar.
Na gu' na gu' cham jix bhɨɨ gu maa'nkar bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu Jordaan tu' jix duñia' na gu' gu bhóogɨt tu' gu kutun gu maa'nkar dhi' baasɨ'n gu Jordaan tas buusñi.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix aa' gu Moisees; gio ba' tu' xoi'kam tu' gu takarui' na ba' tu' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Jordaan vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx ka'm ka't baas obhɨɨ'ñ vupui bhaan.

Jano' ba' ka't gu oi'ñga'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu ñi'ook ka't gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook na ba' bɨɨx gu Jawatan Dios na ba' bɨɨx gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr dhi' gu oidha' ka't gu maa'nkar vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Gu' gu' tu' cham xoi'kam gu suudai' gu novɨ uañi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' uañi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jɨ'dɨlh na ba' a'aalh gu takarui' na ba' kakneer xoi'kam tu' gu ñi'ook gu chin.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Gad gu ma'nkam gu Rubeen gu Moisees bham; gio ba' tu duukam jix duu na ja'p gu Jawatan tu' jix aa'ñdhix.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook a'aalh gu ñi'ook gu u'vɨ gu ñi'ook gu suudai' bɨx gu ñi'ook gu vaakax no'm gu oi'ñga'n jɨ'dɨlh gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' tu duukam gu ñi'ook bɨx bhɨɨ'ñdham gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Jawatan tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Moisees gu Eleasar jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Josuee gu mar gu Nun chiñia' tattat bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.

Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees; gio ba' tu' gu ma'nkam gu Gad gu ma'nkam gu Rubeen gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu Jordaan gu ñi'ook bɨx bhɨɨ'ñdham vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu oi'ñga'n ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ vupui bhaan gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu oidha' gu Galaad gu maa'nkar.
Gu' gu' tu' cham gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu ñi'ook jano' ba' jix duñia' gu maa'nkar tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu Kanaan.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Gad gu ma'nkam gu Rubeen tu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook tu duukam.
Jano' ba' no'ch gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu oidha' gu Kanaan gu maa'nkar gu kutun gu maa'nkar ka't dhi' baasɨ'n gu Jordaan.

Jano' ba' jix maa gu Moisees gu ma'nkam gu Gad gu ma'nkam gu Rubeen ɨraab bopxi'ñ gu Manasees gu mar gu Josee oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu kutun gu gɨ'kora' gu Amorreo oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu Og gu gɨ'kora' gu Basaan gu oidha' bɨɨx jɨ'dɨlh gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jɨ'dɨlh gu oi'ñga'n xikoolh.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Gad gu ñi'ook gu Diboon gu Atarot gu Aroer.
Jano' ba' gu Atrot-sopan gu Jaser gu Jogbaa.
Jano' ba' gu Bet-nimra gu Betaraan; gio ba' jɨ'dɨlh jix kavɨk gio gu takarui' na ba' kakneer.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Rubeen gu ñi'ook gu esboon gu Eleale gu Kiriataim.
Jano' ba' gu Nebo gu Baal-meoon gu suudai' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Sibma; gio ba' jix dhaas gu tɨɨgɨ' jɨ'dɨlh gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Makîr gu mar gu Manasees jix bɨɨx duu gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook mi'x juu'ñ gu Amorreo ka't.
Jano' ba' gu Moisees jix maa gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Makîr gu mar gu Manasees jix daa.
Jano' ba' gio gu Jair gu mar gu Manasees ka't jix bhɨɨ taañpu' jix dhaas gu ux gu tɨɨgɨ' gu abot-jair.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu Noba ka't jix bhɨɨ gu Kenat taañpu' jup tɨɨt gu Noba jurtu'nka' gu tɨɨgɨ'.

Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu Elim jix duñia' ju'ñdharan gu gɨ' suudai' gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu Repidim jix duñia' oidha' jix gaki gu Sinaii.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug oidha' jix gaki gu Sinaii jix duñia' gu Kibrot-ataaba.

Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu aserot jix duñia' gu Ritma.

Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu arada jix duñia' gu Makelot.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu Makelot jix duñia' gu Taat.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu Taat jix duñia' gu Tara.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu Mitka.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu Mitka jix duñia' gu asmona.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu asmona jix duñia' gu Moserot.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu Moserot jix duñia' gu Bene-jaakaan.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu Bene-jaakaan jix duñia' gu kavɨk gu ux.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu kavɨk gu ux jix duñia' gu Jotbata.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu Jotbata jix duñia' gu Abrona.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu Abrona jix duñia' gu Esion-geber.

Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu Aaroon jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu kavɨk gu or jurtu'nka' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix koi oo'm gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu oidha' gu Ejipto gu takarui' jixchamaam maa'n gu takarui'.

Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' gu Obot.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu Obot jix duñia' gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Moab.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu ja'tkam jix duñia' gu Dibon-gad.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu Dibon-gad jix duñia' gu Almon-diblataim.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu Almon-diblataim jix duñia' gu kakkavɨk gu Abarim vupui bhaan gu Nebo.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu kakkavɨk gu Abarim jix duñia' vaak ja'tkam gu Moab ju'ñdharan gu Jordaan gu Jerikoo.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' ju'ñdharan gu Jordaan dɨr gu Bet-jesimot bɨɨx ka'm gu Abel-sitim vaak ja'tkam gu Moab.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees vaak ja'tkam gu Moab ju'ñdharan gu Jordaan gu Jerikoo bham.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu takarui'; na pai' dhuuk gu oi'ñga'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jordaan gu oidha' gu Kanaan.
Jano' ba' mi'x juu'ñ bɨx jix koi gu oi'ñga'n vupui bhaan gu takarui' tu jiim bɨx gu jodai' bɨx gu chuukug gu takarui' jix duñia' bɨx gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' mi'x juu'ñ jix koi gu oidha' jix daa; na gu' tu' jix maa na ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu ux mamai'chɨk gu ux ja'tkam vaak; gio ba' mui'x jix duñia' jix jai' gu ux gu maa'nkar gu vaak jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu ux gu maa'nkar gu jodai'; na pai' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oi'ñga'n maa'n; jano' ba' gu ux bopxi'ñ tattat gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' tu' cham mi'x juu'ñ jix koi gu oi'ñga'n vupui bhaan gu takarui' gu chuukug mi'x dhaas ka't gu ux gu takarui' gu vupui gu ux jo'ii' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai' bhaan gu oidha' gu takarui' gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook na ja'p tu' gu jodai' duñia'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu takarui'; na pai' dhuuk gu oi'ñga'n kia'mi'ñ gu oidha' gu Kanaan maachim gu oidha' tu' gu chuukug gu maa'nkar pai' gu Kanaan bhaan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook saagi'ñ dɨr oidha' jix gaki gu Sin bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook gu Edom; gio ba' ka't gu ñi'ook saagi'ñ gu ñi'ook gu gɨ' suudai' gu chuukug bhaan tas buusñi.

Jano' ba' dhi' gu ñi'ook dɨr saagi'ñ bɨɨx ka'm jix tɨ'ɨ gu Akrabbim gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm gu Sin; gio ba' gu suudai' ka't saagi'ñ gu Kades-barnea; mi' dhɨr gu jodai' gu asar-addar gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm gu Asmoon.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook dhi' gu ñi'ook dɨr gu Asmoon bɨɨx ka'm bhi'ñbak gu Ejipto gu oi'ñga'n ka't tas gei'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ka't gu gɨ' suudai'; gio ba' dhi' gu ñi'ook ka't gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook ka't dhi'; gio ba' dɨr gu gɨ' suudai' nɨi'ñchudat gu kavɨk gu or.
Jano' ba' gu kavɨk gu or nɨi'ñchudat ba'k gu chuukug ka't gu suudai' mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Sedad.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' dhi' gu ñi'ook gu Sipoon ka't gu oi'ñga'n gu asar-enaan; gio ba' dhi' ka't gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ux gu ñi'ook tas buusñi nɨi'ñchudat dɨr gu asar-enaan bɨɨx ka'm gu Sepam.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' dhi' gu ñi'ook dɨr gu Sepam gu Ribla tas buusñi gu Ain; gio ba' jix dhaav gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu gɨ' suudai' gu Kinneret tas buusñi.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr jix dhaav dhi' gu ñi'ook gu Jordaan ka't gu suudai' gu gɨ' suudai' gu Salado; gio ba' dhi' ka't gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr gu ux gu ñi'ook xikoolh.
Jano' ba' jix aa'ñdhix gu Moisees gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bham; gio ba' dhi' gu oidha' gu ñi'ook gu ux gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix aa'ñdhix gu Jawatan Dios koi gu ñi'ook bopxi'ñ ɨraab bopxi'ñ.
Na gu' na gu' bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Rubeen bhaan gu vaak tattat bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Gad bhaan gu vaak tattat ɨraab bopxi'ñ gu Manasees jix duñia' jix bhɨɨ gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gook bopxi'ñ ɨraab jix bhɨɨ gu maa'nkar dhi' baasɨ'n gu Jordaan gu Jerikoo tas buusñi gu jodai' gu tas.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu tɨɨgɨ' gu chichio'ñ jix duñia' gu oidha'; gio ba' gu Eleasar jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Josuee gu mar gu Nun.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gio bopxi'ñ gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' na ba' gu chuukug gu maa'nkar gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu tɨɨgɨ' gu chichio'ñ; gio ba' bopxi'ñ gu Judaa gu Kaleb gu mar gu Jepone.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Simeoon gu Samueel gu mar gu Ammiud.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu Benjamiin gu Elidad gu mar gu Kisloon.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Dan gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu Bukki gu mar gu Jogli.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Josee; gio ba' bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Manasees gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu aniel gu mar gu Epod.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Epraim gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu suudai' gu mar gu Siptaan.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu ñi'ook gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu Elisapaan gu mar gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Issakâr gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu Paltiel gu mar gu Asan.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Aser gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu Aiud gu mar gu Selomi.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu chuukug gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu Pedael gu mar gu Ammiud.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam jix aa'ñdhix gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu oi'ñga'n gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu oidha' gu Kanaan.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees vaak ja'tkam gu Moab ju'ñdharan gu Jordaan gu Jerikoo bham.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix maa gu Lebitas gu maa'nkar jɨ'dɨlh gu suudai'; gio ba' gio jix duñia' gu Lebitas gu jodai' jix duñia' jɨ'dɨlh xikoolh.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook jɨ'dɨlh na ba' jix daa gu jodai' ka't na ba' gu vaakax na ba' gu suudai' na ba' bɨx gu vaakax.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' jɨ'dɨlh jix duñia' gu Lebitas ka't jix bhai'x gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ xikoolh dɨr gu tasi' kiicham na ba' gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' mai' kiicham baasɨ'n tas buusñi gook jix bhai'x gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ baasɨ'n saagi'ñ gook jix bhai'x gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ baasɨ'n tas gei'ñ gook jix bhai'x gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ baasɨ'n gu ñi'ook gook jix bhai'x gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ kiicham tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' dhi' jix duñia' gu ux gu jodai' jɨ'dɨlh.
Jano' ba' jɨ'dɨlh jix duñia' gu Lebitas gu ux jɨ'dɨlh ka't gu jodai' jix duñia' na ba' mua'kam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' gu suudai' jix duñia' oo'm gook jɨ'dɨlh.
Jano' ba' bɨx jɨ'dɨlh jix duñia' gu Lebitas ka't oo'm gu tasi' jɨ'dɨlh; gio ba' bɨɨx gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' jɨ'dɨlh jix maa gu maa'nkar gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix jai' jix bhɨɨ jix jai' gu vaak jix bhɨɨ gu vaak; gio ba' maa'n jɨ'dɨlh gu Lebitas bhaan gu maa'nkar oidha' maa'nkar.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu takarui'; na pai' dhuuk gu oi'ñga'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jordaan gu oidha' gu Kanaan.
Jano' ba' nɨi'ñchudat jɨ'dɨlh gu jodai' jix duñia' pai' gu bhóogɨt mua'kam gu chuukug oi'ñdha' koi'm gu ux gu vaak.
Jano' ba' ka't mii' dhɨr jɨ'dɨlh gu ux gu jodai' jir bɨx bhai' cham koi mua'kam bɨɨx ka'm ñi'ook na jir bhai' vupui bhaan gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jɨ'dɨlh jix duñia' gu ux jɨ'dɨlh gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' vaik jɨ'dɨlh jix duñia' dhi' baasɨ'n gu Jordaan vaik jɨ'dɨlh jix duñia' gu oidha' gu Kanaan; gio ba' ka't jɨ'dɨlh gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu ux jɨ'dɨlh ka't na ba' gu jodai' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix duñia' jix koi tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ba' gu bhóogɨt no'x gu chuukug koi'm gu ux gu vaak.
Jano' ba' tu' bɨɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix kavɨk jodai gu chuukug gu jodai' mua'kam; gio ba' mua'kam koi.
Jano' ba' tu' bɨɨx gu jodai gu novɨ gu bhóogɨt koi gu chuukug gu jodai' mua'kam; gio ba' mua'kam koi.
Jano' ba' tu' bɨɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oi'ñga'n gu novɨ gu bhóogɨt koi gu chuukug gu jodai' mua'kam; gio ba' mua'kam koi.
Jano' ba' jir bɨx bhai' jix koi gu ñi'ook mua'kam; na pai' dhuuk gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' gu ux gu ja'tkam jix duñia' bhaan gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux gu takarui' suulhgidha'.
Jano' ba' gu ux gu jodai' naaka'n bɨɨx gu novɨ jix koi; gio ba' gu ux koi; mi' dhɨr mua'kam; na pai' dhuuk jir bɨx bhai' jix koi gu ñi'ook mua'kam na pai' dhuuk gu oi'ñga'n.
Gu' gu' tu' jix bhai'x jix duñia' cham gu jodai' jix duñia' bhaan gu chuukug gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ cham gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' jix duu xoi'kam cham tɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug bhaan gu ñi'ook gu jodai gu ñi'ook koi gu jodai' cham ka't bhaamki'ñdha' tu' jix duñia' cham bhai'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux jir bɨx bhai' jix koi jurtu'nka' dhi' ñi'ook na tu a'ga.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' mua'kam gu novɨ jir bɨx bhai' jix koi gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu ñi'ook kiicham gu jodai' ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' jix koi bɨɨx ka'm gu jodai' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan ka't maa'n bɨɨx bɨ'ñdhatu' jix bhaan.
Jano' ba' tu' mua'kam gu ñi'ook mai' gu ñi'ook kiicham gu kutun jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jir bɨx bhai' jix koi gu ñi'ook mai' gu ñi'ook kiicham gu ñi'ook jir bɨx bhai' jix koi mua'kam gu bhóogɨt cham jix duñia' gu ux gu i'ii'ñ.
Na gu' kiicham gu kutun gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt jix daa bɨɨx ka'm gu jodai' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan; gio ba' mi' dhɨr gu jodai' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan mua'kam gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu maa'nkar.
Jano' ba' dhi' tu'x ka't gu ux jir bɨx bhai' gu ñi'ook gu ux gu bhóogɨt bɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' no'x gu chuukug oi'ñdha' gu ux tu ñi'ook gu tasi' koi mua'kam; gu' gu duukam gu tasi' cham jix duñia' tu' bhaan gu ñi'ook na ba' gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' cham jix bhɨɨ u'uuk gu ux gu oidha' mua'kam; na gu' gu ux koi'm; gu' jix bhai'x koi.
Jano' ba' tu' gu suudai' jix bhɨɨ u'uuk jix duñia' kiicham gu kutun na ba' jix duñia' duaka' gu oidha' bɨɨx ka'm gu jodai' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' cham jix duñia' gu oidha' pai'; na gu' dhi' gu ɨ'ɨr jix duñia' gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr pai' cham ka't gu chuukug gu ɨ'ɨr ka't gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu ux gu ɨ'ɨr ja'aa.
Jano' ba' cham gu chuukug gu oidha' pai' gu bhóogɨt tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu bhóogɨt; na gu' tu' gu Jawatan Dios gu bhóogɨt tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' chiñia' tattat ja'tkam vaak gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu mar gu Makîr gu mar gu Manasees ja'tkam vaak gu ma'nkam gu Josee; gio ba' tu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu Moisees chiñia' ɨɨbhidham tattat gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' gui'p; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix gu Jawatan gu ux gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ koi gu oidha' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu maa'nkar; mi' dhɨr gio tu' jix aa'ñdhix gu Jawatan Dios gu Jawatan jix maa gu maa'nkar jix duñia' chulhiiñdha' xibhɨk ma'nkam u'uuvɨ.

Jano' ba' tu' gu jodai' bɨɨx dhɨt gu ma'nkam bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu oi'ñga'n ka't gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n taata'n tattat ka't gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n bopxi'ñ ka't maa'n; gio ba' ka't gu oi'ñga'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu kutun gu maa'nkar.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu oi'ñga'n gu jodai' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu maa'nkar ka't gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar bopxi'ñ bɨpna'; gio ba' gu maa'nkar ka't gu oi'ñga'n gu maa'nkar bopxi'ñ taata'n tattat.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Moisees jix aa'ñdhix gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu ux tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bham; gio ba' bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Josee tu ñi'ook jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' dhi' tu' jix aa'ñdhix gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook ma'nkam u'uuvɨ jix duñia' bham; gio ba' gu takarui' na ja'p gu suudai' cham gu ñi'ook ja'tkam vaak bopxi'ñ gu taat jix duñia'.
Na ba' na ba' gu maa'nkar gu ma'nkam gu Israeel cham ka't bhaan bopxi'ñ; na gu' maa'n gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix duñia' gu maa'nkar bopxi'ñ tattat.

Jano' ba' no'x mar u'vɨ gu vupui gu maa'nkar bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bɨɨx oi'ñdha' ja'tkam vaak bopxi'ñ gu taat jix duñia' na ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim maa'n gu maa'nkar tattat.
Jano' ba' cham gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar gu ñi'ook bopxi'ñ; gu' bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu maa'nkar.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix gu Moisees jix duu ma'nkam u'uuvɨ jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu Maala gu Tirsa gu ogla gu Milkâ gu Noa ma'nkam u'uuvɨ jix duñia' bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' ja'tkam vaak gu ma'nkam gu Manasees gu mar gu Josee jix bɨɨx duu gu u'vɨ; gio ba' gu maa'nkar jix duñia' bopxi'ñ ja'tkam vaak gu taat.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu ñi'ook ñi'ook kavɨk jix aa'ñdhix gu Jawatan Dios gu ux gu novɨ gu Moisees gu ma'nkam gu Israeel vaak ja'tkam gu Moab ju'ñdharan gu Jordaan gu Jerikoo.
